JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

Language:

To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

Buscamos uma pessoa com perfil colaborativo e que atue como referência técnica em iniciativas de segurança em DevOps, para trabalhar na integração de práticas de segurança nos pipelines de desenvolvimento e infraestrutura da empresa, contribuindo com a automação, confiabilidade, segurança e observabilidade dos nossos ambientes.   • Domínio de containers e orquestração com Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Terraform e Helm;
  • Domínio em Git, GitOps, GithubActions, ArgoCD e etc;

DIFERENCIAIS QUE TE DESTACAM:

  • Experiência com Zero Trust Architecture e gerenciamento de identidade (IAM).

  • Conduzir treinamentos e sessões de awareness sobre segurança para áreas técnicas;

title: Lead AI Engineer
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Lead AI Engineer role at Sierra Studio

Sierra Studio is an AI engineering studio and startup incubator – we turn our customers’ ideas into reality! We’re based in Los Angeles, but our teammates live all around the world. We create products across all areas of software — from web and mobile apps to cutting-edge work at the forefront of AI and large language models.

About The Role

As a Lead AI Engineer, you’ll lead engineering for one or more AI initiatives at Sierra. You’ll architect the stack, prompt engineer LLMs to solve real world problems, and work with your teammates to do whatever it takes to ship great products. You’ll work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to take products from idea to production. As an early employee at a startup, you’ll also be part of creating our culture!

  • Client projects: Work with a startup founder to build the MVP of their idea
  • Internal projects: Build an internal AI tool to transform our own workflows
  • Hiring: Help us grow our team and interview future candidates
  • Leadership: Mentor other engineers to level up our team

We’re looking for a lead engineer who has experience building great products with LLMs, whether that’s at work or on personal projects.

  • You’ve built something cool with LLMs, whether it was for work or a personal project
  • Experience with prompt engineering, RAG, and agentic patterns
  • Experience building evals for LLM-powered products
  • Growth mindset: Ability to quickly learn new skills in the AI space
  • Strong curiosity about AI and the impact of LLMs
  • Ability to lead the technical direction of products from idea to production
  • Ability to work effectively with product, design, and other partners
  • Ability to contribute to multiple projects at the same time
  • Software engineering
  • Backend: Either Python (e.g. FastAPI) or TypeScript experience is nice to have!

Bonus skills – nice to have!

  • Experience with finetuning LLMs
  • Staying up to date with latest research papers in AI
  • Uses AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, etc) to supercharge your own coding workflow
  • You have interesting personal projects you can share with us!
  • Growth mindset : We look to magnify our strengths, take chances, and always learn from our mistakes.
  • Supportive : We keep our egos out of the workplace and support each other when trying new things.
  • Product & customer centric : We care deeply about our customers and clients and always keep their needs top of mind. We build tech to solve real problems.
  • Ownership : We take initiative, even when it is “not our job.” As a startup, we all wear lots of hats.

Why join us?

At Sierra Studio, we believe in nurturing talent and creating good vibes at work. We seek inclusion and embrace our differences. We’re all about “growth mindset”, and we look to magnify our strengths, take chances, and always learn from our mistakes. We don’t fit our teammates into boxes, and instead we understand that each person has their own unique set of skills that they bring to the table. If you join us, we’ll embrace who you are today, and give you the space and tools to keep growing.

Salary Range: $60,000 - $80,000 annually.

Your exact compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors that reflect your individual qualifications and how they align with the needs of the role.

Job Description

Join the team redefining how the world experiences design. This role is fully remote and can be based anywhere; Canva’s headquarters are in Sydney, Australia, and the team spans the globe.

Where And How You Can Work

Our headquarters is in Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. Since we don’t have a physical campus in Brazil, this role is fully remote — giving you the flexibility to do your best work from wherever you thrive.

What You’d Be Doing In This Role

As Canva scales, change continues to be part of our DNA. This will give you the flavour of the type of things you’ll be working on when you start, but it will likely evolve.

At the moment, this role is focused on:

  • Leading reseller relationships across Latin America — onboarding, enabling, and growing performance with key partners.
  • Designing and delivering training, tools, and co-branded campaigns to help partners effectively promote Canva’s offerings.
  • Driving channel sales growth through business planning, performance tracking, and joint sales initiatives.
  • Representing Canva externally — supporting partners and stepping in with customers when needed.
  • Championing the voice of our resellers internally to ensure they have the support and resources to succeed.

You\'re Probably A Match If You Have

  • Extensive experience across channel management, partnership development, or business development, with a focus on large resellers or channel sales.
  • A proven track record of managing and developing successful reseller programs or indirect sales channels.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Analytical skills, with the ability to leverage data to make informed decisions and drive performance improvements.
  • Experience working with CRM systems (Salesforce) and other partner management platforms is preferred.
  • Experience working with large resellers in Latin America, with a good contact network.
  • Direct customer sales experience desirable, but not mandatory.
  • Must be fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is advantageous.

About The Team

The Partnerships team sits within our Sales & Success Supergroup and plays a pivotal role in expanding Canva’s reach and impact through strategic, scalable relationships. We partner with leading technology platforms, agencies, and ecosystem players to unlock new growth channels and embed Canva into the workflows of teams and organizations around the world. Our team thrives at the intersection of creativity and commerce—bringing commercial rigour, go-to-market creativity, and deep collaboration to every partnership.

What\'s In It For You?

Achieving our big goals motivates us to work hard — and we do — but you\'ll experience moments of magic, connectivity, and fun woven throughout life at Canva. We offer a range of benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.

  • Equity packages — we want our success to be yours too
  • Inclusive parental leave policy
  • An annual Vibe & Thrive package to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more
  • Flexible leave options to recharge and support you personally

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

Other Stuff To Know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva, so even if you don’t feel your skills match what’s listed above — we still want to hear from you. Interviews are conducted virtually.

A Tag Registradora é uma infraestrutura financeira regulada pelo Banco Central do Brasil, com a missão de trazer mais eficiência, transparência e segurança para o mercado de recebíveis. A missão da Tag é conectar os diversos agentes do ecossistema — adquirentes, subadquirentes, bancos, fintechs e empresas — por meio de tecnologia robusta e processos seguros, apoiando a modernização do sistema financeiro brasileiro.

  • Atuação estratégica de desenvolvimento de negócios: atuar de forma consultiva e analítica, conectando oportunidades do mercado às soluções da TAG; entender o comportamento do mercado e dos concorrentes para antecipar tendências e criar diferenciais competitivos.

title: SOFTWARE ENGINEER I
description:
Overview

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é ser uma pessoa Software Engineer: Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora curiosa, com paixão por aprender sobre tecnologia e que goste de solucionar problemas. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de crescer e se desenvolver com o time, sendo responsável por:

  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento e na manutenção de novas funcionalidades, sempre com a orientação de pessoas mais experientes ;
  • Contribuir no desenvolvimento de sistemas importantes para a companhia, aprendendo as melhores práticas de mercado;
  • Ajudar a monitorar o desempenho e o impacto das alterações nos sistemas;
  • Documentar as soluções desenvolvidas para compartilhar conhecimento com o time;
  • Aprender e aplicar conceitos importantes para nós, como: Desempenho, Escalabilidade, Segurança e Confiabilidade em nossas aplicações.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Conhecimentos básicos ou acadêmicos em C# e no ecossistema .NET;
  • Interesse em aprender e escrever testes automatizados ;
  • Noções de Bancos de dados relacionais (como PostgreSQL ou SQL Server);
  • Curiosidade sobre arquitetura de microsserviços ;
  • Ser uma pessoa colaborativa, aberta a participar de Code Reviews para aprender e também para contribuir com sua perspectiva.

O que aumenta as suas chances:

  • Experiência com sistemas de mensageria (Ex: RabbitMQ, Kafka);
  • Noções, mesmo que teóricas, sobre modelagens de bancos de dados Relacionais e não Relacionais ;
  • Interesse em cultura DevOps e ferramentas de CI/CD ;
  • Vontade de conhecer mais sobre o mercado financeiro .

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Digital, da Vitta: contamos com uma equipe médica multidisciplinar, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia 7 dias por semana
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação
  • Auxílio Remoto + Setup Inicial (exclusivo para vagas remotas)
  • Horário flexível
  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e vídeo aulas
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Vale Transporte (exclusivo para vagas presenciais)

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

  • Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco. Nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!
  • Entrevistas com o time de People: Momento de nos conhecermos! Papo com o time de recrutamento para entender cultura, estrutura e o desafio.
  • Avaliação Técnica: Aprofundamento nas hard skills. Normalmente envolve duas conversas ou um desafio para avaliar habilidades técnicas e conhecer possíveis pares e liderança.
  • Check de Cultura: Papo com uma pessoa guardiã da cultura para alinhar crenças, jeito de pensar e visão de futuro.
  • Feedback: Compartilharemos o retorno independentemente do resultado e definiremos próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos as melhores pessoas para melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its App of the Day.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

With the growth of our iOS app, being the #18 productivity app in the App Store category and also our recent recognition as Apple's 2025 Design Award for inclusivity, we find the need for a Senior iOS Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push our missing forward.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

What You’ll Do

  • Opportunity to lead key engineering and product decisions
  • Actively shipping production code for the Speechify iOS app
  • Work within a dedicated product team
  • Participate in product discussions to shape the product roadmap
  • Maintain and enhance the existing complex app architecture

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Experience. You\'ve worked on products that scaled to a large user base
  • Track record. You have worked on various products from inception to decent traction. You have been responsible for engineering the product
  • Customer obsession. We expect every team member whose responsibilities directly impact customers to be constantly obsessed about providing the best possible experience
  • Product thinking. You make thoughtful decisions about the evolution of your product and support internal teams and designers into taking the right direction
  • Speed. You work quickly to generate ideas and know how to decide which things can ship now and what things need time
  • Focus. We’re a high-growth startup with a busy, remote team. You know how and when to engage or be heads down
  • Technical skills. Swift, SwiftUI

Technical Requirements

  • Swift Programming Language
  • SwiftUI experience
  • Experience in Multithreading Programming
  • Working with CI/CD infrastructure
  • Experience with Fastlane
  • SOLID principles, the ability to write every single class according to SOLID
  • Experience with Git and understanding of different Git strategies

What We offer

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product
  • An entrepreneurial crew that supports risk, intuition, and hustle
  • The opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry
  • A competitive salary, a collegiate atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture
  • Work on a product that millions of people use and where daily feedback includes users sharing that they cried when they first found the product because it was so impactful on their lives
  • Support people with learning differences like Dyslexia, ADD, Low Vision, Concussions, Autism, and Second Language Learners, and give reading superpowers to professionals all over the world
  • Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech: Intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Audio

title: Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish It Industry
description:
Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish It Industry

Join to apply for the Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish It Industry role at Nexer Telescope.

Sweden needs skilled engineers! About 30 000 of them by 2030, according to the Swedish Statistical Central Bureau. We currently have about 200 open positions for software engineers with our clients in Sweden. Are you ready to help?

Job Description

As a senior headhunter you will help us find engineers who are ready to embark on an adventure to Sweden. Living standards in Sweden are high by international comparisons, and we need many engineers. Your job will be to find them and inform them about the benefits of living and working in Sweden. To move to another country is often one of the biggest leaps in life, so a lot of your job will be to build trust with suitable candidates. You will be supported by a global team of recruiters and an executive management team in Sweden, as well as our Swedish delivery management team that handles relocation for our consultants. In short we fix everything for our employees — visa, work permits, tickets, housing, you name it. Our clients are primarily within software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development. Your work will be planned and executed with colleagues in Albania, Argentina, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Colombia, Hungary, Kenya, North Macedonia, Sweden, Turkey, Ukraine, Venezuela and Vietnam. You will be part of an efficient team with a strong focus on helping engineers and their families build a new career and life in Sweden. Telescope's core values are joy, trust, and professionalism.

Required competence

Required competence (please ensure this is documented in your CV): At least 5 years of professional experience from recruitment in the IT sector, or similar technical experience.

  • A solid and well proven network of local engineering talent within IT.
  • Extremely service oriented, with a flexible mindset towards always finding the best solution for the challenge at hand.
  • High quality and brand awareness.
  • Understanding or interest in headhunting and the principle of IT outstaffing/outsourcing companies.
  • Upper intermediate English.
  • Knowledge of contemporary IT technologies and methods, and ability to learn new technologies.
  • Analytical, well organized with attention to detail, with the ability to identify and close a recruitment request.
  • Self confident, sociable, outgoing with high self-motivation.
  • Resilient, capable of turning a "no" into an opportunity to try harder.
  • Passionate about success with an executive yet relaxed attitude toward work, colleagues and customers.
  • Responsive and responsible with a professional appearance.

title: Channel Account Manager (SA32)
description:
Overview

The Brazil Channel Account Manager role is a key function and the central hub around which all partner productivity and value is created. This role requires an entrepreneurial spirit, willingness to work hard, and the ability to creatively problem solve with a strong sense of outcome ownership. The candidate must communicate clearly across marketing, operations, finance, accounting, and sales within Datalogic and with identified partners to express the vision for their business and outline specific needs to work toward that vision. Location is remote from Brazil with the ability to travel extensively (50%+ of the time) across the region.

Role Mission

To be successful, identify key partners in the market and develop a shared 3–5-year strategy with each to grow their business with Datalogic in a consistent and predictive way.

Responsibilities

  • Engage with channel partners to drive productivity and value creation for the business.
  • Communicate the vision and partner needs across marketing, operations, finance, accounting, and sales within Datalogic and with partners.
  • Develop and implement a shared long-term strategy (3–5 years) with key partners.
  • Travel extensively across the region (50%+).

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) in business, economics, marketing, or related field.
  • Fluent English; written and verbal communication skills.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing distribution partners, including business plan development, contract execution, and partner relationship management.
  • Deep understanding of channel and distribution models with strong analytical and strategic planning skills.
  • Proven experience in developing and executing business plans.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and organizational abilities.
  • Experience in bar code scanning, mobile computing, wireless technology (Wifi, WLAN, Bluetooth) preferred.
  • Negotiation and presentation skills; ability to present to multi-level clients.
  • Willingness and ability to travel extensively (50%+ of the time) across the region.

Other Information And Skills

  • Results orientation: drive to achieve short- and long-term goals.
  • Customer focus: identify and meet customer needs (internal or external).
  • Interpersonal characteristics: open, communicative, collaborative, trustworthy, and able to handle constructive conflict.
  • Motivational characteristics: high energy, competitive drive, autonomy, and ability to work with less structure.
  • Sense of urgency: proactive problem identification and action.

Company Background

Datalogic is a global technology leader in automatic data capture and factory automation, specializing in barcode readers, mobile computers, sensors, RFID, vision, and laser marking systems. Coordenador de Desenvolvimento Galênico (Medicamentos Novos)
Da Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento & Inovação (PDI)
Se você é apaixonado por pesquisar e desenvolver medicamentos e novas opções terapêuticas, movido por desafios, melhorias e tendências de mercado, comprometido com os resultados e tem brilho nos olhos ao atuar com inovações, essa oportunidade é para você! #Vem Ser FQM
O Grupo FQM é uma empresa da Indústria Farmacêutica que atua há 93 anos no Brasil (desde 1932), faz parte do Grupo Roemmers, multinacional com sede na Argentina, posicionado entre os cinco maiores grupos farmacêuticos da América Latina. No Brasil, a FQM ocupa a 12ª posição do ranking da Indústria Farmacêutica com faturamento acima de 2 bilhões de reais ao ano. Com um amplo portfólio de medicamentos, suplementos, cosméticos atua em 02 segmentos: Medicamentos de prescrição médica (RX) em diversas especialidades terapêuticas, e consumo (OTC) produtos para o autocuidado, isentos de prescrição médica, destinados diretamente ao consumidor final.
A FQM, com mais de 1500 colaboradores, vem escrevendo sua história através de constante aprimoramento do seu portfólio de produtos e processos e da busca incessante pela inovação e excelência para atender às necessidades do mercado farmacêutico no país, promovendo Saúde, Autoestima, Bem-estar e Qualidade de Vida à toda população.
Descrição sumarizada: Coordenar o desenvolvimento de novos produtos, conduzindo pesquisas e projetos, desenvolvendo fórmulas, demandando a compra de materiais produtivos, validando lotes piloto, elaborando dossiês e realizando a transferência de tecnologia para a área de produção, com o objetivo de ampliar o portfólio de produtos da FQM, contribuindo diretamente para a evolução do nosso portfólio e excelência dos nossos medicamentos.
Local de atuação: Planta Fabril Rio de Janeiro – Rua Viúva Cláudio, 300 – Jacaré, RJ
Principais Atividades

  • Coordenar a captação de informações e ideias da sua equipe de desenvolvimento, definindo indicadores que orientem a criação de projetos alinhados aos valores e objetivos da FQM.
  • Direcionar as propostas de pesquisa e formulação de novos produtos, garantindo coerência científica e viabilidade técnica desde o início.
  • Coordenar pesquisas relativas aos produtos em avaliação, com o objetivo de levantar dados e informações que sustentem o desenvolvimento da fórmula e do processo de produção adequados às moléculas trabalhadas e, com a conclusão desta etapa, designar o projeto para o pesquisador responsável.
  • Gerir e acompanhar os projetos iniciados, validando a formulação e o processo delineados.
  • Avaliar os fornecedores de insumos e/ou serviços selecionados por sua equipe, negociando condições e selecionando o que melhor se adapta ao modelo de negócio da FQM.
  • Coordenar a produção de lotes piloto em escala industrial, garantindo conformidade com as especificações e acompanhamento dos estudos de estabilidade dos novos fármacos.
  • Coordenar a elaboração dos dossiês técnicos dos produtos desenvolvidos, consolidando documentação de fórmulas e processos para o registro oficial junto aos órgãos reguladores.
  • Finalizar a etapa de desenvolvimento com a transferência completa do conhecimento técnico para o setor produtivo, viabilizando a fabricação em escala e garantindo a qualidade e eficácia dos produtos reproduzidos.
Requisitos
  • Formação superior completa preferencialmente em Farmácia.
  • Pós-graduação, MBA ou especialização em Gestão de Projetos, áreas técnicas afins ou em Liderança/Gestão de Pessoas será um diferencial.
  • Imprescindível vivência de 5+ anos com desenvolvimento de novos medicamentos na Indústria Farmacêutica (IF);
  • Conhecimento avançado em gestão de projetos, incluindo o controle minucioso de etapas e o acompanhamento rigoroso dos prazos, com reporte estruturado ao longo de todo o ciclo.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office, principalmente Excel, Power Point e MS Project;
  • Proatividade, orientação a resultados, planejamento, determinação, capacidade analítica, boa comunicação, liderança, perfil curioso e inovador, comprometimento com metas e prazos e bom relacionamento interpessoal
  • Excelente capacidade de relacionamento com os médicos, líderes de opiniões, farmacêuticos etc.

  • Disponibilidade participação em eventos e em feiras do setor (FCE, FISA, NIS, COSMETICS) além de visitas à parceiros ou empresas terceirizadas.

title: Associate Director of Ventures & Entrepreneurship
description:
Overview

The Associate Director is responsible for strategy development and implementation of a vision and infrastructure to establish and accelerate a Howard community culture of entrepreneurship that spans research institutes, colleges, departments, alumni, and other Historically Black Colleges and Universities.

Supervisory Authority

The Associate Director will initially manage our team of consultants who currently assist the Tech Transfer and Commercialization Unit with specialized support, including venture coaching, market analysis, and startup guidance. This supervisory responsibility includes task delegation, performance oversight, and coordination of deliverables to ensure alignment with unit objectives.

Nature And Scope

Strategic Collaboration with Entrepreneurship Programs and Partners

  • Build entrepreneurship capacity across campus by supporting faculty, students, and staff with commercialization opportunities. The Associate Director will coordinate outreach and plans for entrepreneurs with other stakeholders and entrepreneurship programs in the Howard ecosystem.
  • The Associate Director is also expected to foster a robust regional entrepreneurial ecosystem by developing strategic relationships with peer technology incubator leaders (particularly in the DMV and other HBCUs), community business and civic leaders, relevant state and federal agencies, as well as alumni. This includes developing strong external relationships with angel investors, venture capital firms, accelerators, serial entrepreneurs, mentors, government entrepreneurship programs, and commercial partners that can support the success and growth of startup companies from Howard.
Guidance and Business Development to Entrepreneurs and Small Businesses
  • Lead an incubation methodology and programming pathway for clients of Ventures and Entrepreneurship based on their business needs and stage of development.
  • Inspire Howard aspiring entrepreneurs and support their new ventures by identifying, recruiting, and making introductions to appropriate advisors, mentors, investors, corporate partners, and service providers. This includes marketing and organizing information on a “portfolio” of Howard startup companies to help share opportunities with potential partners.
  • Champion support for diverse entrepreneurs on campus through programs that increase inclusion, training, management assistance, and seed funding.

Manage Incubator Activities

  • Manage PitchHU Incubator and GrowHU Accelerator programs in collaboration with external partners. Deliver entrepreneurship programming, collaborate with corporate partners, and build a robust, innovative community at Howard.
  • Develop program metrics, track the services provided, and develop reporting mechanisms for internal and external audiences. This includes the use of the Salesforce platform and other data management systems to manage client information and tracking of business progression.
  • Oversee the preparation of information on incubator activities and performance for stakeholders at Howard.

Support Entrepreneurship and Economic Development with External Funding

  • Spearhead the submission of grants for new federal and state funding to support entrepreneurship and technology commercialization programs at Howard, in order to increase new venture creation and support the research and innovation competitiveness of the campus. This includes work with departments, institutes, and investigators on campus to develop entrepreneurship capabilities within new centers and federally funded programs.
  • Support outreach to other incubator locations in the DMV to provide expertise, sharing, and operations guidance. This includes support grant programs that assist entrepreneurs throughout Illinois.
  • Coordinate entrepreneurship programs with other colleges and universities which elevate technology entrepreneurship programs throughout other HBCUs, including resources and capabilities across the Howard community and other HBCUs.

Principal Accountabilities

The Associate Director of Ventures and Entrepreneurship is responsible for leading the strategic development and operational execution of entrepreneurial and venture creation initiatives within the Office of Research’s Technology Transfer & Commercialization Unit. Reporting to the Director of Technology Transfer & Commercialization, this role plays a critical leadership position in expanding the university’s innovation ecosystem by supporting the formation, incubation, and growth of university-affiliated startups and faculty−, student−, and community−led ventures.

Key Accountabilities Include

  • Designing and implementing programs that translate Howard University’s research, intellectual property, and creative works into viable startup and spinout companies.
  • Leading the Grow|HU and Venture|HU initiatives by managing entrepreneurial pipelines, spinout support services, and venture−readiness programming.
  • Building and maintaining a network of venture capitalists, angel investors, alumni entrepreneurs, and industry mentors to provide capital and guidance to emerging ventures.
  • Working in close coordination with internal partners (e.g., Office of Corporate Relations, Office of the General Counsel, Office of Innovation & Economic Development, Schools and Colleges) to align commercialization and venture goals across the university.
  • Advising faculty, students, and staff on business model development, startup formation, and investment strategies tailored to deep tech, life sciences, software, and creative sector ventures.
  • Establishing performance metrics and reporting mechanisms for tracking startup creation, funding secured, and economic impact from entrepreneurial activities.
  • Representing Howard University at national and regional convenings focused on inclusive innovation, HBCU entrepreneurship, and university spinouts.
  • Managing program staff, budgetary resources, and strategic partnerships that strengthen Howard’s capacity to serve as a launchpad for underrepresented founders and scalable ventures.
  • Supporting the Director in institutional planning and fundraising efforts that enhance the university’s visibility and competitiveness in translational research and startup acceleration.

Core Competencies

  • Leadership
  • Interpersonal Skills
  • Communications
  • Partnership Management
  • Contract Negotiation and Management
  • Strategy Development
  • Mentoring

Minimum Requirements

Minimum Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, science, technology, business administration, finance, or related field. A minimum of 10 years of management experience within a business enterprise and/or entrepreneurial incubator, including prior experience with technology commercialization based on innovative research, developing customers, direction from a board of directors/advisors, and growth stage progression. Prior experience with venture capital, angel investment, and SBIR/STTR funding for small business financing, which includes an understanding of term sheets, cap tables, and investment/funding options for startup companies. Experience developing and directing technology commercialization programs, understanding of technology startup company challenges and resources needed, and an ability to empower and develop company founders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or equivalent degree strongly preferred. Grant administration and reporting with government agencies. Experience in higher education administration, including work with faculty and graduate students to develop new ventures, license technology, and successfully commercialize research.
  • Experience with entrepreneurship ecosystems, business incubators, small business mentoring, accelerators, and commercialization programs. Salesforce or other CRM software experience with data management, metrics, dashboards, and presentation of analytics.

Job description

Somos a Conexa , ecossistema digital de saúde integral, líder na América Latina . Unimos pacientes, profissionais, empresas e operadoras com o objetivo de reduzir as ineficiências de custo e qualidade de atendimento do sistema de saúde brasileiro.

A Conexa está revolucionando o acesso à saúde e, para continuarmos crescendo de forma sustentável e eficiente, estamos em busca de uma liderança estratégica para a nossa área de Performance e Planejamento.

A sua missão será construir e liderar o processo de Planejamento Integrado de Saúde (S&OP), conectando as áreas de Growth, Operações Assistenciais, Negócios e Finanças. Você será a pessoa responsável por garantir que nossa capacidade de atendimento e nossa demanda de pacientes estejam perfeitamente equilibradas, otimizando a utilização de nossos recursos, reduzindo custos e, o mais importante, garantindo a melhor experiência para nossos pacientes.

Se você é apaixonado por dados, obcecado por eficiência e tem experiência em construir processos de planejamento do zero, esta é a sua oportunidade de deixar uma marca profunda em uma empresa de alto crescimento.

Aviso importante!

A Conexa nunca cobra qualquer valor para participação em seus processos seletivos. Todas as nossas vagas são divulgadas exclusivamente pela Gupy e o processo de inscrição é totalmente gratuito . Caso receba qualquer pedido de pagamento ou oferta de vaga fora da Gupy, desconfie! Isso não faz parte da nossa prática de recrutamento.

Main responsibilities

Você será responsável por:

  • Estruturar e Liderar o Processo de S&OP: Desenhar e implementar o ciclo de planejamento integrado da companhia, definindo cadências (semanais, mensais, trimestrais), rituais e fóruns para tomada de decisão colaborativa entre as áreas.
  • Gestão de Capacidade vs. Demanda: Analisar profundamente nossa capacidade médica (oferta) versus a previsão de demanda, identificando ociosidade, gargalos e oportunidades de otimização para garantir a máxima taxa de ocupação e o menor custo por consulta.
  • Ownership do Forecast: Assumir a responsabilidade pelo processo de previsão de demanda, trabalhando em parceria com a área de Growth para medir, desafiar e calibrar os modelos, garantindo alta acurácia e visibilidade de curto, médio e longo prazo.
  • Fomentar a Cultura de Dados: Padronizar e governar os principais KPIs da operação (ex.: taxa de ocupação, custo por consulta, no-show), desenvolvendo dashboards e relatórios que tragam transparência e embasem todas as decisões estratégicas.
  • Análise de Custos e Interface com Finanças: Atuar como um parceiro estratégico do time Financeiro, analisando as variações de custo assistencial, apoiando a estruturação dos processos de pagamento e garantindo a saúde financeira da operação.
  • Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Time: Liderar, mentorar e desenvolver a equipe de analistas de performance, transformando a área em um centro de excelência técnica e estratégica dentro da companhia.

Requirements and skills

Esperamos de você:

  • Sólida experiência em áreas de Planejamento (S&OP, IBP, FP&A), Business Intelligence ou Planejamento Estratégico.
  • Experiência comprovada em liderança e gestão de equipes.
  • Forte habilidade analítica e quantitativa, com domínio em ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados (SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Looker ou similar).
  • Experiência com modelagem de dados, forecasting e análise de cenários.
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders, com capacidade de influenciar líderes de diferentes áreas.
  • Conhecimentos que te destacam:
  • Experiência no setor de saúde, healthtechs ou empresas de tecnologia com operações complexas (marketplaces, logística etc.).
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação para análise de dados (Python ou R).
  • Experiência em projetos de otimização de custos e eficiência operacional.

Visão Geral da Função

Como Arquiteto de Sistemas , você terá um papel fundamental no design e na entrega de soluções de dados escaláveis, seguras e eficientes dentro da organização de Managed Data Services da PwC .

Sua capacidade de resolver problemas complexos, executar proof-of-concepts (POCs) e desenvolver frameworks reutilizáveis será essencial para impulsionar a inovação e o sucesso da equipe.

Principais Responsabilidades

Design Arquitetural e Documentação

  • Desenvolver modelos arquiteturais C4 , utilizando ferramentas diagram-as-code como Structurizr para modelos C4 e PlantUML ou Mermaid para diagramas de sequência.
  • Contribuir para os High-Level Designs (HLDs) e traduzi-los em Low-Level Designs (LLDs) , incluindo diagramas de classes, de sequência e de fluxo de dados.
  • Identificar e assumir features de habilitação arquitetural desde a ideação até o design e entrega.
  • Definir e documentar requisitos funcionais e não funcionais de acordo com o design final.

Desenvolvimento e Execução de Soluções

  • Conduzir POCs e pesquisas para explorar novas tecnologias, frameworks e abordagens.
  • Liderar pelo exemplo, atuando de forma prática no código, especialmente em C# , incluindo conceitos avançados como Dependency Injection , Clean Architecture e Domain-Driven Design .

Colaboração e Alinhamento Estratégico

  • Garantir consistência, alinhamento e uma visão arquitetural coesa entre múltiplas equipes.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de DevOps, SRE, Operações e Engenharia para assegurar integração e implantação contínua das soluções.
  • Atuar em conjunto com Solution Architects, PMs e Tech Leads para garantir coordenação e alinhamento estratégico.
  • Fornecer orientação clara e eficaz às equipes de desenvolvimento sobre a implementação de soluções arquiteturais, incluindo revisões de código e conformidade com padrões.
  • Definir e manter arquiteturas de referência e melhores práticas para soluções escaláveis e reutilizáveis.
  • Dar aprovação arquitetural em features durante o Program Increment (PI) Planning e Architectural Runway .

Operações e Melhoria Contínua

  • Identificar e mitigar riscos técnicos associados a novas iniciativas e tratar proativamente possíveis armadilhas.
  • Liderar a elaboração de ARRs, TRFs, pré-avaliações de Procurement e Tech Registration para novos aplicativos/serviços.
  • Desenvolver e manter documentação técnica, incluindo integrações entre serviços e configurações específicas de ambientes.
  • Apoiar operações em produção, assegurando confiabilidade e performance das soluções implantadas.
  • Garantir conformidade com as políticas da PwC, requisitos de segurança e mitigação de vulnerabilidades por meio de ferramentas aprovadas.

Requirements and skills

Qualificações Necessárias

  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração para trabalhar com equipes e stakeholders diversos.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas, com atenção aos detalhes.

  • Sólido conhecimento em linguagens de programação (C# preferencialmente; Python desejável ), incluindo Dependency Injection e padrões avançados de design.
  • Experiência em plataformas de dados cloud-native , especialmente Azure Databricks, Fabric e Purview .

  • Experiência prévia como Arquiteto de Sistemas , além de 2+ anos como Tech/Engineering Lead e 7+ anos como Desenvolvedor .

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independentes do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro. Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado.

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer a transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo.

Requisitos e diferenciais

  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente no Rio de Janeiro;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter – prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Atuação em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc.);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI).

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (Renda Fixa, Renda Variável, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação CPA-20, fornecemos o curso gratuitamente, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro).

Desafios e impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos e identificação de oportunidades;

  • Saúde: plano de saúde sem coparticipação (inclui dependentes); iFood Benefícios (VA e VR flexível); licença parental: maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias; auxílio creche.

title: Consulting Senior Director - Supply Chain Automation
description:
Overview

Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes. Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. Investing in partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful change. To succeed long-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients. Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise. Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

Responsibilities

  • Identify, design, and drive intelligent automation solutions to develop and implement strategies for supply chain cost reduction and efficiency.
  • Leverage automated solutions to optimize the review of purchased services, clinical supplies, and GPO contracts.
  • Collaborate with clinical teams to streamline procurement of clinical supplies and physician preference items using technology.
  • Participate in the development and implementation of intelligent automation tools to drive best practices in inventory management.
  • Assist in developing proposals and presentations for potential clients, highlighting technological efficiencies.
  • Build relationships with internal and external stakeholders, focusing on technology-driven initiatives.
  • Communicate progress and outcomes of supply chain improvements to executive leadership.
  • Lead cross-functional teams to achieve organizational goals through innovative solutions.
  • Identify and implement intelligent automation opportunities to streamline internal supply chain methodologies with a focus on improving quality and reducing the cost to deliver.
  • Identify third-party solutions and relationships to accelerate supply chain intelligent automation through partnerships and potential acquisitions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor\'s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in healthcare supply chain management and consulting.
  • Proven track record of designing supply chain intelligent automation solutions to achieve cost reductions and process improvements.
  • Strong knowledge of GPOs, clinical supplies, physician preference items, and purchased/support services.
  • Experience with current and evolving inventory management systems and automation technologies within the healthcare and supply chain industries.
  • Experience with developing automated or AI solutions to meet internal or client needs; Data Science or Engineering experience preferred.
  • Experience with Large Language Models and their use in the healthcare industry.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Compensation

The estimated base salary range for this job is $215,000 - $265,000. The range represents a good faith estimate of the range that Huron reasonably expects to pay for this job at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes, and required travel. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay-for-performance philosophy. Inclusive of annual incentive compensation opportunity, the total estimated compensation range for this job is $268,750 - $350,750. The job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s benefit plans which include medical, dental and vision coverage and other wellness programs. The salary range information provided is in accordance with applicable state and local laws regarding salary transparency that are currently in effect and may be implemented in the future.

Por isso, todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas. Aqui, não apenas reconhecemos, mas também celebramos as diferentes identidades, experiências e talentos de cada pessoa que faz parte do nosso time.

E estamos com uma vaga aberta para Engenheiro de Dados Sênior , que irá atuar dentro do nosso time de Delivery Team, providenciando soluções, modelagens e arquiteturas para o fluxo de dados do nosso cliente e seus pipelines, apoiando na priorização de demandas e implementações, servindo de referência técnica aos demais do time.

Responsibilities

  • Modelagem de dados: Desenvolver modelos de dados dimensionais, utilizando as melhores práticas de modelagem para Big Data.
  • Arquitetura de dados: Projetar e implementar arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e resilientes.
  • Pipelines de dados: Construir e otimizar pipelines de ETL/ELT robustos e eficientes para dados em tempo real ou batch de variadas origens de dados (arquivos, APIs, logs, bases SQL e NoSQL).
  • Qualidade de dados: Garantir a qualidade e a consistência dos dados através de processos de validação e limpeza.
  • Otimização de desempenho: Identificar e implementar melhorias de desempenho em consultas e pipelines de dados.
  • Colaboração: Trabalhar em colaboração com outras equipes (engenharia, ciência de dados, BI) para entregar soluções de dados que atendam aos requisitos do negócio.
  • Apoiar e mentorear engenheiros de dados juniores, promovendo o crescimento técnico e profissional da equipe.
  • Documentação técnica: Capaz de documentar cada etapa de implementação do projeto, escrevendo para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

Qualifications

  • Google Cloud: Experiência sólida com os principais serviços de dados do GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, etc.).
  • Linguagens de programação: Proficiência em Python (orientado a objetos) e bibliotecas (pandas, numpy) e SQL. Conhecimento em outras linguagens como C, PHP, Java é um diferencial.
  • Modelagem de dados: Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem relacional e dimensional com técnicas de normalização e desnormalização.
  • Arquitetura de dados: Sólido entendimento de arquiteturas de dados escaláveis, tanto para processamento em batch quanto em tempo real.
  • Data Warehouse: Experiência com BigQuery, incluindo otimização de consultas e modelagem de dados para análise.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Medical Specialist role at Innodata Inc.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company with more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities. We are an AI technology solutions provider for technology companies and sectors including financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced ML/AI technologies with a global workforce of subject matter experts and a secure infrastructure, we support AI development and applications across healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health, and biomedical research.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will help shape how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, focusing on microbiological sciences. You will evaluate AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform improvements to AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses on topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.

  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Masters or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.

At Amazon, we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. We distribute millions of products each year to our loyal customers across more than 100 countries. We foster a culture of ownership, continuous learning, and data-driven decision-making, empowering our employees to think big and bring their ideas to life.

Role Overview

As an Area Manager - Outbound and Delivery, you will play a crucial role in our complex and fast-paced logistics network. This dynamic position combines responsibilities across our Fulfillment Center (FC) and Delivery Station (DS) operations, requiring a versatile leader who can seamlessly manage both outbound processes and delivery preparations.

You’ll be at the forefront of our customer-facing operations, ensuring that millions of packages are processed efficiently and prepared for timely delivery. Your focus will span four key areas: safety, quality, customer experience, and productivity. You’ll be responsible for leading a diverse team of associates, optimizing processes, and driving continuous improvement in our outbound and delivery operations.

This role offers a unique opportunity to gain comprehensive experience in Amazon’s logistics ecosystem. Your decisions and innovations will directly impact Amazon’s ability to meet and exceed customer expectations, playing a vital part in our mission to be Earth’s most customer-centric company.

As an Area Manager, you’ll also be instrumental in shaping Amazon’s future leaders. You’ll mentor and develop your team, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation. This role is ideal for those who thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex problems, and are passionate about delivering results that directly impact customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership : Manage and develop a team of warehouse associates and delivery personnel; oversee performance, provide training, and address team member needs; collaborate with other Area Managers to balance labor and ensure efficient operations.
  • Operational Management : Review work forecasts and set productivity targets to meet overall building objectives; oversee the outbound process from order fulfillment to last-mile delivery preparation; monitor and improve KPIs such as On-Time Dispatch and First Day Delivery Success.
  • Safety & Compliance : Implement and support all safety programs and ensure OSHA compliance; maintain a safe work environment for all associates in both FC and DS areas.
  • Process Improvement : Identify and lead process improvement initiatives using Lean tools; analyze metrics to find root causes and drive operational enhancements; develop practical solutions to complex problems without compromising quality.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration : Liaise with internal teams and external partners to ensure smooth outbound and delivery operations; communicate daily metrics and report exceptions to relevant departments.
  • Innovation & Adaptability : Embrace and lead change in Amazon’s fast-paced environment; support the implementation of new systems and processes in outbound and delivery operations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
  • Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
  • Ability to push and pull wheeled dollies loaded with products up to 100 pounds during shifts
  • Fluent in English (speaking, writing, and reading)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (speaking, writing, and reading)
  • Employee and performance management experience
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.

Through our pragmatic composability approach, we empower brands, distributors, and retailers with unparalleled flexibility and comprehensive solutions, enabling them to invest solely in what provides a clear business advantage and boosts profitability. title: CX Performance Manager
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a CX Performance Manager in our CX Global area in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Portugal.

The team's mission is to drive Customer Experience performance improvement by leveraging analytical insights and hypothesis testing to identify key opportunities. The position has shifted from primarily focusing on problem identification to requiring this person to create action plans and roadmaps to follow through on resolutions. This change adds a layer of communication and senior leadership because the professional will need to convince other areas to invest in resolving the problems, requiring negotiation skills with major stakeholders. The role covers all four Wellhub verticals (user, client, partner, risk) both regionally and globally.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Reporting directly to the CX Insights leader, build Performance team from scratch overviewing customer experience performance globally
  • Act as the point of contact for customer experience performance requests
  • Identify areas of operational improvement on all four Wellhub verticals (user, client, partner, risk) both regionally and globally
  • Apply strong quantitative skills to formulate, test, and validate data-backed hypotheses, ensuring all conclusions are data-supported and translate into clear, actionable strategies.
  • Proactively set action plans to untap new customer experience opportunities; preparing and leading initiatives and its roadmap
  • Manage a broad base of cross-functional stakeholders, both internally and externally, across multiple departments at a global scale
  • Monitor the overall performance of customer experience operations among all business units and countries, reacting to gaps observed via proposing short and long term corrective actions
  • Conduct studies and drive conclusions that will support executives to take operations’ performance decisions
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Bachelor's degree in STEM field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics)
  • Strong analytical skills, with solid experience on problem solving techniques and hypothesis testing
  • Proved critical thinking with the ability to analyse complex sets of data and derive clear, actionable recommendations
  • Solid stakeholder management, with ability to build and present performance results to executives in a clear and executive way
  • Advanced knowledge of business intelligence tools to work in partnership with the technical team members on conducting robust business analysis that involve exploring data, discussing alternatives and lining up proposals
  • Experience in management or strategic consulting is desirable
  • Advanced English skills (mandatory)

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in project and stakeholder management are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND BELONGING at Wellhub

  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, with excellent written and verbal communication.

ERM is committed to providing a service that is consistent, professional and of the highest quality to create value for our clients.We have worked with many of the Global Fortune 500 companies delivering innovative solutions for business and selected government clients helping them understand and manage the sustainability challenges that the world is increasingly facing.

The key sectors we serve include Oil & Gas, Mining, Power, and Manufacturing, Chemical and Pharmaceutical. All face critical sustainability challenges and our clients in these and many other areas rely on our ability to assist them operate more sustainably which has a positive impact on our planet.

title: Senior Payroll & Tax Analyst
description:
TRM Labs is a blockchain intelligence company committed to fighting crime and creating a safer world. By leveraging blockchain data, threat intelligence, and advanced analytics, our products empower governments, financial institutions, and crypto businesses to combat illicit activity and global security threats. At TRM, you'll join a mission-driven, fast-paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily. Whether analyzing blockchain data, developing cutting-edge tools, or collaborating with global organizations, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact.

We are seeking a Senior Payroll & Tax Analyst who will play a critical role in ensuring compliance, accuracy, and scalability across TRM’s payroll and tax infrastructure. As a fully remote, global company operating across multiple U.S. states and international jurisdictions, TRM faces complex payroll tax requirements that demand specialized expertise. This is an ideal role for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, has a meticulous eye for detail, and is energized by building efficient, compliant processes that reduce risk and improve employee experience.

The Payroll & Tax Operations Specialist will join a high-performing Finance team that leads with ownership, accountability, and a commitment to excellence. You’ll work cross-functionally with HR, Finance, and Legal to deliver timely and accurate payroll, resolve tax issues, and implement process improvements that scale with TRM’s growth. This role is critical to maintaining compliance, ensuring employees are paid correctly and on time, and supporting broader corporate tax needs.

The impact you will have:

  • Own payroll operations end-to-end : Review and finalize payroll within 48 hours of cut-off, consistently achieving <1% error rates and 100% on-time processing across all pay cycles.
  • Ensure tax compliance : Manage multi-state payroll tax filings, resolve tax notices within 5 business days, and complete monthly reconciliations with no material variances to support Finance’s accurate reporting.
  • Support corporate tax activities : Contribute to broader tax compliance needs, including preparation of tax provisions and support for federal, state, and indirect tax (e.g., sales tax, VAT) obligations.
  • Drive process and automation improvements : Identify and implement workflows or automation enhancements annually to reduce manual work, minimize compliance risk, and improve scalability.
  • Partner cross-functionally : Provide timely, accurate data and reporting to HR and Finance (e.g., headcount reports, tax provisions, employee tax queries) while maintaining strong relationships and high partner satisfaction.

What we’re looking for:

  • 4+ years of payroll operations and payroll tax compliance experience, ideally in a SaaS or high-growth, multi-state environment.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. federal and state payroll tax regulations; exposure to indirect taxes (e.g., sales tax, VAT) strongly preferred.
  • Experience with payroll systems and tax platforms; ability to support a system transition (we will be moving off IBP) and optimize workflows for scalability.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, paired with an ownership mindset and ability to manage 3–4 concurrent payroll/tax priorities without delays.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience performing reconciliations and identifying root causes of variances.
  • Clear, proactive communicator who builds trusted relationships with cross-functional stakeholders and resolves issues quickly.

Life at TRM Labs

Leadership Principles shape everything we do—how we make decisions, collaborate, and operate day to day.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer – We put customers first, driving for speed, focus, and adaptability.
  • Master Craftsperson – We prioritize speed, high standards, and distributed ownership.
  • Inspiring Colleague – We value humility, candor, and a one-team mindset.

Accelerate your Career

At TRM, you’ll do work that matters—disrupting terrorist networks, recovering stolen funds, and protecting people around the world. You will:

  • Work alongside top experts and learn every day.
  • Embrace a growth mindset with development opportunities tailored to your role.
  • Take on high-impact challenges in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Thrive in a culture of coaching, where feedback is fast, direct, and built to help you level up.

What to Expect at TRM

TRM moves fast—really fast. We know a lot of startups say that, but we mean it. We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. As a result, you’ll be joining a team that’s highly engaged, mission-driven, and constantly evolving.

To support this intensity, we’re also intentional about rest and recharge. We offer generous benefits, including PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave for full time employees.

That said, TRM may not be the right fit for everyone. If you’re optimizing for work life balance, we encourage you to:

  • Ask your interviewers how they personally approach balance within their teams, and
  • Reflect on whether this is the right season in your life to join a high-velocity environment.
  • Be honest with yourself about what energizes you—and what drains you

We’re upfront about this because we want every new team member to thrive—not just survive.

The Stakes Are Real

Our work has direct, real-world impact:

  • Jumping online after hours to support urgent government requests tracing ransomware payments.
  • Delivering actionable insights during terrorist financing investigations.
  • Collaborating across time zones in real time during a major global hack.
  • Building new processes in days, not weeks, to stop criminals before they cash out.
  • Analyzing blockchain data to recover stolen savings and dismantle trafficking networks.

Thrive as a Global Team

As a remote-first company, TRM Labs is built for global collaboration.

  • We cultivate a strong remote culture through clear communication, thorough documentation, and meaningful relationships.
  • We invest in offsites, regional meetups, virtual coffee chats, and onboarding buddies to foster collaboration.
  • By prioritizing trust and belonging, we harness the strengths of a global team while staying aligned with our mission and values.

Join our mission!

We’re looking for team members who thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and love building from the ground up. TRM is remote-first, with an exceptionally talented global team. If you enjoy solving tough problems and seeing your work make a difference for billions of people, we want you here. Don’t worry if your experience doesn’t perfectly match a job description — we value passion, problem-solving, and unique career paths. If you’re excited about TRM’s mission, we want to hear from you.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement. Privacy Policy

title: NB - QA Automation Engineer - 186
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Software Quality Engineer to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in ensuring the delivery of high-quality software products that power our omni-channel retail experiences. The ideal candidate will leverage advanced automation frameworks, AI-driven testing tools, and behavior-driven development methodologies to enhance test coverage, efficiency, and reliability. As a Senior Software Quality Engineer, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including developers, product owners, and designers—to translate complex business requirements into robust, maintainable test scenarios that mirror real-world user behavior. Your expertise will directly impact the seamless integration of eCommerce and in-store digital experiences, driving innovation and excellence in our software quality assurance practices.

Responsibilities

  • Execute and maintain automated test suites using both the existing Selenium-based framework and the emerging AI-driven test platform, applying intelligent strategies to improve test coverage and efficiency.
  • Write and maintain test cases using Gherkin syntax in C# and JavaScript, leveraging tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate test development and improve code quality.
  • Perform AI-assisted exploratory testing to uncover edge cases, usability issues, and regressions—using machine learning insights to guide test focus and prioritize risk areas.
  • Use Applitools Eyes for visual validation across responsive web and in-store digital experiences, integrating visual AI into the quality pipeline.
  • Collaborate closely with developers, product owners, and designers to translate business requirements into intelligent, maintainable test scenarios that reflect real-world user behavior.
  • Validate omni-channel workflows such as BOPIS, BORIS, Endless Aisle, and Membership across both eCommerce and in-store systems, using AI to simulate complex user journeys and edge cases.
  • Participate in agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment, advocating for the use of AI in test planning, execution, and reporting.
  • Coordinate with Quality Engineers across ~9 other scrum teams to ensure consistent test coverage and quality standards across shared eCommerce and retail platforms, promoting AI-driven testing practices across teams.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in software quality engineering or test automation, preferably in agile product teams.
  • Proficiency in C# for writing and maintaining automated tests.
  • Experience with Selenium, Gherkin, and BDD frameworks (e.g., SpecFlow, Cucumber).
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted testing tools and techniques, including exploratory testing guided by machine learning insights.
  • Hands-on experience using GitHub Copilot or similar AI coding assistants to accelerate test development and improve maintainability.
  • Experience with visual testing tools such as Applitools Eyes.
  • Strong understanding of functional, integration, and end-to-end testing in web and omni-channel retail environments.
  • Ability to collaborate across multiple scrum teams and domains within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).
  • Passion for applying AI to software testing—across test design, automation, diagnostics, and exploratory testing.
  • Excellent communication skills and a proactive, quality-first mindset.
