title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend | Product Engineering
description:
Overview

TRM Labs is a blockchain intelligence company committed to fighting crime and creating a safer world. By leveraging blockchain data, threat intelligence, and advanced analytics, our products empower governments, financial institutions, and crypto businesses to combat illicit activity and global security threats. At TRM, you\'ll join a mission-driven, fast-paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily. Whether analyzing blockchain data, developing cutting-edge tools, or collaborating with global organizations, you\'ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact.

Role and Responsibilities

The Product Engineering team is responsible for building a comprehensive set of features, frameworks, and functionalities for both end customers and internal-facing teams to successfully execute and scale TRM\'s business. We are looking for a pragmatic backend engineer who can build reliable and scalable software that will be used by all TRM customers. You\'ll also design backend APIs with a deep understanding of the customer experience and performance.

As an early member of the team, you will be deeply involved in the technical details along with our operational processes to champion the velocity, quality, and overall impact of TRM, ultimately building a safer financial system for billions of people.

Impact you\'ll have here:

  • Work on complex engineering problems that help you build and hone not only technical skills but also project management and human/soft skills
  • Develop and maintain public APIs that are part of the API Product suite
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on transforming a functional vision into a tangible roadmap with clear outcomes
  • Support and enable internal business units through shared engineering services and functionalities
  • Develop cross-functional relationships with stakeholders across the organization to understand and empower their mission from end to end
  • Experience designing and building scalable systems, web applications, APIs, and services (our backend is built in Node.js but prior experience in Node.js is not required; we believe tools and languages can be learned on the job)

Qualifications

What we\'re looking for:

  • Experience designing and building scalable systems, web applications, APIs, and services.
  • An understanding of storage systems such as relational databases (e.g., Postgres) and analytical databases.
  • Demonstrated experience in understanding customer pain points and bridging their needs to technical & product requirements.
  • A high degree of initiative and ownership, combined with the ability to navigate ambiguity and adapt quickly to change.
  • Exceptional ability to structure problems and identify the most critical issues to prioritize.
  • Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences, verbally and in writing.
  • Experience working collaboratively in a cross-functional environment with a diverse group of people at all levels in an organization.

About the Team

  • The team operates on a weekly sprint schedule. Individuals on the team are tasked to lead projects as technical anchors, and given a chance to grow and take ownership according to their level and goals. We work closely with our internal stakeholders to deliver impactful features to our internal customers and the company.
  • The team\'s culture is built on psychological safety wherein team members build rapport and trust-based relationships with teammates, hold each other accountable and to a high bar, collaborate extensively, and have lots of fun along the way.
  • The team\'s timezone is a mix of EST and PST with at least 6 hours of overlap with PST (8 am to 2 pm PST)
  • On-Call: We have an on-call rotation that is specific to internal tools. In this role, the internal tools engineer is responsible for triaging customer support requests from specific Slack channels pertaining to internal tools.

Life at TRM

  • Our Leadership Principles shape everything we do—how we make decisions, collaborate, and operate day to day.
  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer – We put customers first, driving for speed, focus, and adaptability.
  • Master Craftsperson – We prioritize speed, high standards, and distributed ownership.
  • Inspiring Colleague – We value humility, candor, and a one-team mindset.

What to Expect

TRM moves fast—really fast. We know a lot of startups say that, but we mean it. We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. As a result, you\'ll be joining a team that\'s highly engaged, mission-driven, and constantly evolving.

To support this intensity, we\'re also intentional about rest and recharge. We offer generous benefits, including PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave for full time employees.

That said, TRM may not be the right fit for everyone. If you\'re optimizing for work life balance, we encourage you to:

  • Ask your interviewers how they personally approach balance within their teams, and
  • Reflect on whether this is the right season in your life to join a high-velocity environment.
  • Be honest with yourself about what energizes you—and what drains you

We\'re upfront about this because we want every new team member to thrive—not just survive.

The Stakes Are Real

Our work has direct, real-world impact:

  • Jumping online after hours to support urgent government requests tracing ransomware payments.
  • Delivering actionable insights during terrorist financing investigations.
  • Collaborating across time zones in real time during a major global hack.
  • Building new processes in days, not weeks, to stop criminals before they cash out.
  • Analyzing blockchain data to recover stolen savings and dismantle trafficking networks.

Global Team and Remote Culture

As a remote-first company, TRM Labs is built for global collaboration. We cultivate a strong remote culture through clear communication, thorough documentation, and meaningful relationships. We invest in offsites, regional meetups, virtual coffee chats, and onboarding buddies to foster collaboration. By prioritizing trust and belonging, we harness the strengths of a global team while staying aligned with our mission and values.

Join Our Mission

We\'re looking for team members who thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and love building from the ground up. TRM is remote-first, with an exceptionally talented global team. If you enjoy solving tough problems and seeing your work make a difference for billions of people, we want you here. Don\'t worry if your experience doesn\'t perfectly match a job description— we value passion, problem-solving, and unique career paths. If you\'re excited about TRM\'s mission, we want to hear from you.

EEO and Privacy

TRM Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of protected status. This job posting may include required privacy and compliance statements as allowed by law. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to TRM\'s Privacy Policy and terms of processing personal information.

title: Senior Director of Medical Aesthetic Operations and Market Development
description:
Overview

Under the direction of the Chief Aesthetics Officer, the Senior Director of Medical Aesthetic Operations and Market Development is responsible for the maximization of revenue and profitability of medical-aesthetic services (primarily non-surgical) across all practices. Through the development and implementation of key initiatives relating to Medical Aesthetic operations, including cost control, vendor relations, education & training, development of existing and new services lines, reporting & analysis and events, this role will contribute to platform growth.

The Senior Director of Medical Aesthetic Operations and Market Development will work closely with clinical vendors, Gen-derm operations leaders, and support services department heads to identify system & process needs and effectively project manage to achieve overall company goals. The Senior Director works in partnership with key stakeholders including Physician leaders, Providers and their Medical Aesthetic Staff, Marketing, Operations, and other support services department heads to achieve overall company goals. The Position will have business & financial (non-clinical) oversight for all medical-aesthetics service lines including injectable, laser, plastics, retail, and related spa services. This role will rely heavily on strong communication, innovation, leadership, and the ability to drive results through influence to increase revenue and all profitability metric while increasing provider satisfaction and excellence in patient outcomes. This role will initially not have direct reports, but over time will need to build out a team commensurate with company growth.

Responsibilities

Essential Functions

  • Drive revenue growth in Medical Aesthetics and retail sectors, managing inventory costs and fostering EBITDA growth across the company and at clinic/practice levels. Develop financial budgets to optimize growth and cost management.
  • Assess and enhance Medical Aesthetic clinical processes, identifying areas for improvement and spearheading the implementation of improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with physician practice leaders and regional/local team leaders to craft and execute aesthetic in-office retail and e-commerce business plans.
  • Develop and execute strategies, best practices, and tactics to boost the adoption of aesthetic products and services, aligning with short-term and long-term goals.
  • Partner with procurement to optimize vendor agreements and relationships, securing the most favorable supply costs. Serve as the primary liaison with Forefront Dermatology's aesthetic vendor partners.
  • Ensure price accuracy and minimize costs by monitoring vendor rebate and incentive programs, coordinating with Legal, Compliance, Purchasing Finance, and Operations for timely and accurate payments. Manage and communicate vendor loyalty programs and promotions.
  • Collaborate with marketing to devise impactful in-market strategies and platforms tailored for clinic-level implementation. Work closely with the marketing department to develop branded materials for in-house marketing efforts.
  • Oversee the logistical and financial aspects of Medical Aesthetics event planning, management, and execution.
  • Lead the device business case development process, offering recommendations and advocating for optimal device purchasing and performance strategies. Utilize data on FF devices to determine their placement and usage for maximizing productivity.
  • Provide ongoing education to all providers and relevant staff involved in Medical Aesthetics services, ensuring adherence to best practices.
  • Ensure that all clinics and providers deliver an exceptional patient experience for Medical Aesthetic patients, with a continual focus on reputation management and effective resolution of patient concerns.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required, Master’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years’ experience with associated service lines such as medical cosmetics/ Medical Aesthetics, marketing, and / or beauty retail.
  • Minimum of 10 years’ experience in the physician and/or private clinic healthcare space, multi-unit, multi- region experience preferred (ideally in Dermatology, plastics, cosmetic dentistry, orthodontics or Ophthalmology/ocular or similar cash paying healthcare systems).
  • Minimum of 10 years’ experience operating within a cross functional team as part of a strategic platform.

For this position, the base pay range is $198,000 to $240,000 per year. This position is eligible for our annual incentive program. Individual pay is determined by role, level, location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education ,certifications or training.

  • MLOps / produção: gráficos de drift de dados, distribuição de probabilidades de saída (overconfidence).
  • Métricas de latência/throughput, consumo de GPU/CPU/memória em inferência.

Sr RevOps Engineer at Go Nimbly

Join to apply for the Sr RevOps Engineer role at Go Nimbly

About The Job

At Go Nimbly, we want to be a global thought leader in the RevOps space by developing a badass brand built through innovative work created by individuals with growth mindsets. As a member of the Delivery team, you will help our clients drive more revenue by creating a buying experience that’s both frictionless and human. You will move these high-growth companies towards a more operationally efficient organization.

As a Senior Revenue Operations Engineer at Go Nimbly, you’ll be at the forefront of designing, planning, executing, supporting, and abstracting solutions for our customers and partners. You'll navigate through JavaScript and Salesforce Apex code, demonstrating strategic thinking while remaining detail-oriented and managing multiple projects in parallel.

On a given day, a Sr RevOps Engineer will spend time:

  • Writing Apex, SOQL, JavaScript (server/client), HTML, CSS, React.
  • Implementing open source libraries and design concepts to improve infrastructure.
  • Contributing to all aspects of the process: defining, designing, developing, testing, and supporting.
  • Estimating engineering effort, planning implementation, and rolling out system changes.

What’s in it for you?

  • Flexible working environment: our entire team works remotely, and we have no plans to change this!
  • Tiered incentive program (in addition to base salary) to reward high performers.
  • Gain exposure to several high-growth companies looking to scale and invest in their revenue operations function.
  • Be a part of a dynamic team and collaborate with top industry professionals. Many of our alumni have gone on to become leaders and executives at high-growth companies!
  • Annual camp: we have a yearly offsite to bring the team together, celebrate our successes, and plan the year.
  • Dedicated to employee development and career paths aimed at fostering your growth and your career.
  • 100% paid premiums for US employees’ insurance coverage.

About You

  • You have 6 - 8 years of experience as an engineer in the revenue operations space.
  • You display deep technical expertise in Apex, SOQL, and intermediate expertise in full-stack development. You have an ability to know when to build vs. buy. You can produce/effect high quality code (regardless of language or technology).
  • You have a technical interest, a knowledge of SaaS companies, and excellent presentation skills (all three are part of our day-to-day!).
  • Serious organization and project management skills.
  • A great presenter who builds strong relationships.
  • High attention to quality and detail.
  • Experience with AI capabilities within the Salesforce ecosystem is a huge plus!

About Us

  • We pride ourselves in creating the world’s best revenue operators at Go Nimbly!
  • We are positive people who have a sense of urgency, creativity, and decisiveness coupled with the willingness to work hard and well under pressure.
  • We care about self-betterment and believe in pushing each other to reach our fullest abilities.
  • We are ambassadors of Go Nimbly and actively engage within the Revenue Operations space.

What’s next?

Apply! Rest assured, while AI might feel like it’s taking over the world, we have a human on the other end of the computer personally reviewing each application. Our Talent Acquisition team will reach out if we’d like to speak further about the role. And if not, we promise to let you know because let’s be honest, who enjoys being ghosted when applying for a job? Not only are we committed to getting back to you but we also provide clear feedback.

During the first call with our Talent team, we will lay out the steps in the interview process since it’s unique to each role but typically includes a couple of rounds. We value your time and ours, so we plan to make the best use of our interviews to learn if we are a good fit for you and vice versa.

The base salary for this role is $110,000 - $140,000 USD. Adjustment based on geographical location and final salary decision will be in accordance with leveling. In addition to a base salary, this role is eligible for a performance bonus plan.

description:
We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world—with a scalable brand, culture and services. As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

Role: Data Integration Manager

The Data Integration Manager is the go-to expert for active client integrations within Power Digital’s nova ecosystem. This role owns the design, delivery, and maintenance of custom data pipelines. You will lead scoping calls, gather requirements, and map how a client’s modern data stack connects into our systems. You’ll manage project timelines, set expectations, and act as the primary point of contact from integration design through QA and delivery. You’ll also maintain integrations built through tools like Funnel and Fivetran, and troubleshoot errors.

You’ll partner with Account teams to understand client business goals and with our Data Intelligence team to ensure integrations are structured to power advanced marketing science, and reporting. This role requires ongoing collaboration across technical and client-facing teams to ensure data pipelines are not only operational, but also actionable for marketing science and strategy.

The ideal candidate blends strong technical expertise with polished client-facing skills and a project-owner mindset. You are equally comfortable managing a client relationship, digging into a pipeline error, validating a dataset, or explaining integration progress to stakeholders. Above all, you ensure integrations run smoothly, data is trustworthy, and teams across Power Digital can rely on the foundation you’ve built.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for active client data integrations within the nova ecosystem.
  • Lead scoping calls with clients to gather requirements and map their modern data stack into Power Digital’s systems.
  • Own project timelines and deliverables for custom integrations, ensuring clear communication with both clients and internal teams.
  • Partner with Account teams to align integrations with client business goals and reporting needs.
  • Collaborate with the Data Intelligence team to structure integrations that power advanced analytics, modeling, and marketing science.
  • Build, monitor, and maintain custom data integrations using data share solutions like: SFTP transfer, Snowflake Data Share, and other custom integration methods.
  • Build, monitor, and maintain integrations using tools like Funnel and Fivetran.
  • Troubleshoot connector issues and coordinate timely resolution to minimize downtime.
  • Perform data cleaning, QA, validation, and readbacks to ensure accuracy and reliability of integrated datasets.
  • Support data modeling projects using SQL and dbt.
  • Maintain documentation and best practices for custom integrations.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve integration processes, efficiency, and scalability.

Role Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of experience in data integration, analytics engineering, or a related role.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, or other data programming languages.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex data and integration challenges.
  • Experience in data modeling and ETL workflows.
  • Experience working with modern data stack tools such as Snowflake, dbt, GitHub, Funnel, and Fivetran (or comparable platforms).
  • Familiarity with BI and reporting tools such as Looker (Enterprise and Studio) and/or other visualization platforms.
  • Proven client-facing communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally across technical, analytics, and account management teams.
  • Familiarity with Python or another data-focused programming language (a plus).
  • Prior agency experience or experience managing multiple client stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Understanding of marketing and financial KPIs
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Onboarding Speed & Completion : >90% of new clients with all required data integrated into nova within the first 30 days of onboarding.
  • Connector Uptime & Reliability : >90% uptime of Fivetran/Funnel connections (target ≥ 98%) and average time-to-resolution for connector errors.
  • Data Quality & Accuracy : ≥95% of custom integrations that pass QA/readbacks without critical issues.

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Timely and complete client onboarding integrations
  • Reliable and error-free data pipelines
  • High-quality, validated datasets powering DI and Account teams
  • Clear communication and accountability across client and internal stakeholders

WHO YOU ARE

We expect you to have the following qualifications:

  • You are familiar with frontend stacks like ReactJS, Typescript and BFFs over Node.js, but you like to work with Vanilla JS projects as well;
  • You are familiar with microfrontend architecture;

  • You are proficient in automated testing;
  • You seek to have the highest quality in your products, considering user experience as well as systems\' cost, maintainability, availability and resilience

The following would be considered a plus:

  • Experience with one or more backend programming languages (Kotlin/Java/Ruby/Go/C++/etc.);

We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.
  • CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.
  • CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Bonus Points For

  • Background in OSS-first companies

  • Solid understanding of observability and cloud-native tooling
  • Hands-on experience deploying and operating Kubernetes
  • Bachelor’s degree in CS, IT, Math, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Compensation & Rewards

In Brazil, the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is BRL 543,850 - BRL 652,610. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs\'s success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding – We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key – We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum with 3 days reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to disconnect. We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer

  • Aumentar o pipeline de projetos e buscar novas oportunidades;
  • Acompanhar o pós-venda e garantir a satisfação do cliente;
  • Atingir metas de vendas e indicadores da área.

Requisitos e Habilidades

  • Experiência em vendas de acionamentos, motion control e automação industrial;

title: Engineer, Senior II, Technology- Structural
description:
Are you passionate about being at the forefront of emerging technologies in the maritime and offshore industries?

ABS is a leading Classification Society driven by its mission of promoting the security of life and property and preserving the natural environment. In fulfilling this mission, ABS leads research and develops guidance and requirements focused on the safety of implementing new technology in the marine and offshore environment.

Overview

As a Structural Engineer, you will be actively engaged in driving industry-leading research and development associated with Digital Twin, Structural Repairs utilizing Compound within marine and offshore applications.

What You Will Do:

  • Maintains an active awareness of technical, business, and management developments affecting present and potential customers and communicates this information promptly to the appropriate senior-level managers.
  • Serves as an ABS representative to actively promote the services and capabilities of ABS throughout the business community.
  • Initiate, plan, and execute the technology projects. Provides day-to-day leadership of the project team assigned.
  • Assigns tasks to project team members and monitors the progress of all assigned projects.
  • Ensures the delivery of high-quality service and maintenance of good customer relations.
  • Develops suggested Rule changes and/or Rule development projects as assigned. Advises assigned staff in matters related to the application of Rules and Regulations.
  • Directs the implementation and operation of the ABS Quality System concerning technical work in the assigned jurisdiction.
  • Performs selected engineering support and analyses where necessary.
  • Advises managers of short- and long-term manpower needs in order to ensure that qualified, trained technical staff are available as needs arise and identifies associated training needs.
  • Develops or assists in the development of qualification statements, proposals, and bids; makes presentations of these materials to prospective clients when necessary.
  • Ensures accurate billing to clients on time.
  • Ensures that all ABS Quality System requirements about technical work within the assigned technical area of responsibility are fulfilled.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Minimum 6 years of ABS or direct, hands-on maritime-related industry or research experience.
  • B.S. degree in Naval Architecture, Civil/Structural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, or other related disciplines; an advanced degree is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong communicator with excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Excellent command of the English language.
  • Demonstrated ability to work well with others.
  • A strong background in marine or offshore structures.
  • Hands-on experience in performing structural analysis using ABS engineering applications and commercial finite element analysis software.
  • Ability to lead project bidding and execution, either independently or in a team setting.
  • Ability to perform under pressure and deliver results in a dynamic, fast-paced work environment.
  • Ability to deliver complex messages in simple and understandable ways both verbally and in writing.
  • Essential technical writing skills and experience in preparing formal reports and papers.
  • Working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management System.

Reporting Relationships:

Reports to a Manager or Director.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

  • Automatizar processos de atualização de dashboards e relatórios, promovendo eficiência e governança.
  • Documentar as soluções desenvolvidas, mantendo repositórios organizados e atualizados.
  • Contribuir com a evolução dos frameworks internos de visualização e com a padronização de boas práticas dentro da equipe.

Experiências Desejadas:

  • Conhecimento avançado na ferramenta Power BI, incluindo todas as suas funcionalidades e capacidades.

  • Experiência na importação, limpeza e organização de dados de várias fontes.
  • Conhecimento de princípios e práticas de gerenciamento de dados.
  • Conhecimento de segurança de dados e experiência na configuração de permissões de usuário.
  • Habilidades de resolução de problemas e a capacidade de solucionar problemas técnicos.
  • Conhecimento de SQL, Python (pandas, matplotlib/seaborn), Git
  • Experiência com o Looker Platform (modelagem com LookML, criação de Explores, Dashboards e visualizações customizadas).

About JumpCloud

JumpCloud delivers a unified open directory platform that makes it easy to securely manage identities, devices, and access across your organization. With JumpCloud, IT teams and MSPs enable users to work securely from anywhere and manage their Windows, Apple, Linux, and Android devices from a single platform. JumpCloud is IT Simplified.

This unique team’s charter is to allow organizations to integrate any SaaS products where identities can be sourced and where identities and access needs to be managed. Allowing IT admins to manage user identities in a single source and reflect them to any resource an employee needs access.

You have:

  • A minimum of 3+ years of front-end development experience using Angular (v2 or higher) and TypeScript.
  • Experience creating unit tests using frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest.
  • Strong experience developing RESTful APIs.
  • Deep understanding of object-oriented programming, SOLID principles, and design patterns.

Location:
Fully-Remote (Work from Home), 9 AM - 5 PM CST

Role Overview:
As a Project Manager, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring that all project documentation and workflows are managed accurately and efficiently.   • Project Documentation & Organization:

  • Subcontractor Management & Agreements:

    • Learn the company’s quoting software for windows, cabinets, and doors, and create accurate quotes for materials and services required in real estate development.

  • Scheduling & Weekly Updates:

    • Update and maintain weekly scheduling using Smart Sheet and prepare regular updates for project superintendents.

    • Prepare weekly update sheets and photos for the superintendents to send to clients, keeping them informed on the progress of each project.

  • Training & Adaptability:

    • Train and learn to use new software systems as needed for window take-offs and pricing, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in all tasks.

    • Be adaptable and trainable to learn and integrate new tools and processes as the company grows and evolves in the real estate development field.

  • Client & Contractor Communication:

    • Work closely with project managers, subcontractors, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth communication and project execution.

    • Handle the distribution of AIA form contracts to clients/customers and ensure proper documentation for compliance.

Qualifications

  • Experience:

    • 2+ years experience in project management, or a similar role.

    • Strong command of English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

    • Experience using Bluebeam or similar software for material take-offs and project documentation in the real estate and construction sectors.

    • Knowledge of reviewing submittals and shop drawings and the ability to prepare them for distribution.

    • Experience creating and modifying Gantt chart schedules for tracking real estate development timelines.

    • Familiarity with creating subcontracts and using templates for subcontractor agreements and scope of work documents.

    • Experience with Smart Sheet scheduling and the ability to update schedules weekly.

    • Familiarity with managing lien waivers (partial and final) and AIA form contracts in the real estate development context.

    • Must be adaptable and willing to train on new software tools relevant to real estate and construction processes.

    • Previous experience in the real estate development or construction industry is preferred but not required.

What Success Looks Like

  • Accurate and timely execution of material take-offs and documentation for construction and real estate development projects.

  • Effective management of subcontractor agreements and ensuring all terms are met and paperwork is in order.

  • Successful management of project schedules and timely updates provided to stakeholders.

  • Smooth integration of new software tools, with minimal learning curve and quick adaptation to company processes.

  • Clear communication and proactive problem-solving to support the team and ensure projects stay on track.

Opportunity
This is an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing real estate development firm. As a Project Manager, you will gain valuable experience working on high-profile projects while also having the chance to develop your skills in project management, client communication, and software usage. If you are motivated, adaptable, and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply and contribute to the company’s continued success.

description:
Overview

Behind the scenes of every successful company, there's a team of dedicated individuals committed to ensuring customers receive the support they need. Customer support representatives are essential, handling inquiries, troubleshooting issues, and offering solutions while maintaining a positive approach. A day in the life of a customer support representative involves delivering positive experiences, fostering trust, and leaving a lasting impression. We are a diverse team with individual skills and strengths; when we work as a unit, everyone learns from each other and becomes better equipped to handle new challenges. We offer opportunities for professional development within the company.

As a Customer Support Agent, you are responsible for the effective processing and logistics flow of our total order flow process in the French region and customer satisfaction within the EMEA Fluke Order Management Team. You will handle a variety of tasks while applying communication and problem-solving skills to assist customers with queries, building strong relationships and ensuring loyalty and satisfaction.

Responsibilities

  • Process orders and complaints by researching and resolving problems or complaints regarding inaccurate and/or improper deliveries, damages, and claims.
  • Supply all required information and documents regarding delivery, customs regulation and formalities, transportation/shipping, and invoicing.
  • Inform channel partners about prices, delivery times, the content of the order, and any other commercial information by phone, email, and online.
  • Process quotes based on sales or channel partner input.
  • Responsible for continuous improvement of customer satisfaction.
  • Be part of the multinational Order Management EMEA team which is integral to business success.
  • Recognize the variety of cultures and languages within the team, contributing to a fun, engaging, and supportive environment where input is valued.

Experience

  • Intermediate vocational degree/MBO.
  • Previous experience in logistics or electronic equipment and planning environment is preferred.
  • Proficiency in English and French.
  • Excellent digital literacy, including MS Word, Excel, and Outlook.

Personal Skills

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team.
  • Can-do mentality and strong customer focus.
  • A keen eye for detail.

  • We value humility and are as interested in you as a person as we are in your talent. We believe that diversity drives innovation and contributes valuable insights.
  • Transparency, openness, and a willingness to learn are part of our core values. We offer an international and friendly work environment with energetic company culture.
  • Aligning business and personal needs is important, so we provide flexibility to enable you to bring your best to work.
  • We support important causes and team up to find meaningful ways to give back to the community through the Fluke Day of Caring.
  • Working at Fluke gives you access to a robust career development process and exciting opportunities focused on growth.

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive’s essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We’re a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

  • Comunicação direta: você é uma pessoa comunicadora ativa e ouvinte atenta. Você sabe receber bem feedbacks sinceros e vê cada um deles como uma oportunidade de crescer;

Se você acredita no cuidado que acolhe e quer transformar a saúde no mundo, em nossa área assistenciais você encontra um lugar de cuidado e acolhimento.

Para transformar a saúde é preciso:

É cuidando da nossa gente que vamos ser a saúde que as pessoas desejam e que o mundo precisa, confira os nossos benefícios:

  • Cuidados com a alimentação: Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação ou Refeitório no local de trabalho (de acordo com a localidade);
  • Cuidados com a saúde: Plano de Saúde e Seguro de Vida;
  • Cuidados com o seu desenvolvimento: Universidade Dasa, Ciclo de Desenvolvimento e Carreira, Academias de Tecnologia/PMAX e Programa Crescer dentro da Dasa;
  • Outros: Vale Transporte e Bonificação por desempenho (PPR).

Só a Dasa tem – Programa de Saúde , pautado em 5 pilares:

  • Espiritual: yoga, meditação e mindfulness;
  • Físico: Totalpass, clínica de atenção primária, descontos em exames e vacinas;
  • Intelectual: Universidade Dasa;
  • Relacional: Clube de vantagens UAU e benefícios SESC;

*Os benefícios podem sofrer alteração de acordo com a região e marca da vaga.

Importante: Você está se candidatando para o nosso banco de talentos para vagas em todo o Brasil, nas localidades em que a Dasa possui operações (regiões Nordeste, Centro Oeste, Sudeste e Sul do Brasil), portanto, ressaltamos que assim que surgir uma vaga que melhor se adeque ao seu perfil, entraremos em contato com você. Enquanto isso, mantenha as suas informações atualizadas e cumpra todas as etapas de testes online, assim, podemos conhecer mais sobre você.

Faça parte do futuro da saúde

Somos a Dasa. Cuidamos das pessoas ao longo de toda a vida, de maneira integral e sustentável – dentro e fora da companhia. Contamos com mais de 50 mil colaboradores(as) que cuidam e fazem parte da vida de mais de 20 milhões de brasileiros(as) por ano.

No time assistencial, você encontra um ambiente ágil com pessoas que cuidam, acolhem os(as) pacientes e transformam o jeito de fazer saúde. São mais de 15 hospitais referências e mais de 59 marcas entre medicina diagnóstica e hospitais, distribuídas em mais de 900 unidades no Brasil.

Nosso propósito é ser a saúde que as pessoas desejam e que o mundo precisa.

Para cumprir esse propósito, precisamos de pessoas que contribuam com ideias e conhecimentos , e que juntas possam transformar o presente e o futuro da saúde.

Para nós, diversidade importa!

Reconhecemos que a diversidade amplia a inovação nos ambientes, mas acima de tudo, temos a certeza de que somos parte da transformação. Promovemos dignidade e respeito a todas as pessoas, para que se sintam seguras em ser quem são.

Nossas oportunidades são para todas as pessoas que acreditam na transformação do futuro da saúde. Incentivamos a candidatura de todos que reconhecem a importância da construção de um ambiente livre de preconceitos, assédio e discriminação faça parte da transformação e #VemSerDasa. Juntos entregamos o nosso melhor sempre.

Ser Dasa é ser a pessoa que transforma o futuro da saúde!

Importante: não efetuamos cobranças de taxas em nossos processos seletivos.

  • Solicitar reposição de materiais sempre que necessário, mantendo limpo o local de estocagem;
  • Realizar a limpeza nas dependências, removendo o pó dos móveis, portas, divisórias, varrer pisos, limpar ou lavar, vidros e janelas, removendo o lixo comum e infectante das lixeiras, higienizar/lavar os banheiros;

  • Assistência odontológica

Há 120 anos no Brasil, a Associação Congregação de Santa Catarina (ACSC) é responsável pela administração de 19 entidades com atuação social, em saúde e educação, que formam a Rede Santa Catarina. Com um modelo de gestão em que o superávit gerado é aplicado em nossas obras a fim de executar dignamente nossas atividades, a instituição acolhe e cuida do ser humano em todo o ciclo da vida. Ao todo são cerca de 10,5 mil colaboradores distribuídos em diversas instituições de saúde, mantendo inúmeros estabelecimentos de ensino e acolhendo crianças, adultos e idosos em espaços assistenciais, com atendimento humanizado e serviços de qualidade para milhares de pessoas em seis Estados brasileiros (Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina e São Paulo).

MISSÃO: Acolher e cuidar do ser humano durante todo o ciclo da vida.

VISÃO: Ser referência de entidade filantrópica reconhecida pela sociedade, demonstrando amor às pessoas por meio de nossos atos.

VALORES: Preservação da vida, Humanização, Dignidade, Transparência e Sustentabilidade

title: ELETROMEC NICO
description:
O Oficial de Manutenção Especializada II é responsável por realizar a manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva em sistemas e equipamentos eletromecânicos complexos, assegurando a operação eficiente e segura das instalações. Este profissional atua na identificação e resolução de problemas técnicos, realizando ajustes e reparos especializados para garantir a continuidade das operações.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Executar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva em sistemas eletromecânicos, como motores, bombas, geradores, e sistemas automatizados, conforme os procedimentos estabelecidos.
  • Diagnosticar e resolver falhas em equipamentos eletromecânicos, substituindo componentes danificados e realizando ajustes necessários para garantir o funcionamento adequado.
  • Ler e interpretar esquemas elétricos e mecânicos, manuais técnicos e diagramas para realizar as manutenções e reparos de acordo com as especificações.
  • Realizar testes e medições em sistemas e equipamentos para verificar a eficiência e segurança operacional, utilizando ferramentas e instrumentos apropriados.
  • Desenvolver e implementar planos de manutenção preditiva, monitorando o desempenho dos equipamentos e identificando possíveis falhas antes que se tornem problemas críticos.
  • Manter registros detalhados das atividades de manutenção realizadas, incluindo os materiais utilizados, problemas identificados e soluções aplicadas.
  • Seguir as normas de segurança e procedimentos operacionais estabelecidos, utilizando equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) adequados e assegurando um ambiente de trabalho seguro.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de manutenção e engenheiros para garantir a integração e eficiência dos sistemas eletromecânicos com outros componentes das instalações.
  • Participar de treinamentos e atualizações técnicas para se manter atualizado com as novas tecnologias e práticas de manutenção.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino técnico completo em Eletromecânica, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência prévia em manutenção eletromecânica ou áreas similares, com conhecimento avançado em sistemas e equipamentos eletromecânicos.
  • Habilidade na leitura e interpretação de esquemas elétricos e mecânicos, manuais técnicos e diagramas.
  • Conhecimento das normas técnicas e de segurança aplicáveis à manutenção de sistemas eletromecânicos.
  • Certificações e cursos de especialização em manutenção eletromecânica (desejável).

Localização

Avenida Presidente Wilson, Centro, Rio de Janeiro - RJ, Brasil,

#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: ARTÍFICE ( HIDRÁLICA)
description:
Profissional multifuncional responsável por realizar serviços de manutenção preventiva e corretiva, pequenos reparos e obras em instalações prediais, com ênfase em sistemas hidráulicos. Atua em diversas frentes como hidráulica, alvenaria, pintura e carpintaria, garantindo o bom funcionamento e a conservação das estruturas e equipamentos.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Executar manutenções hidráulicas em tubulações, registros, válvulas, caixas d’água, bombas e conexões, com domínio de sistemas como tubulação do tipo Barbará;

  • Efetuar pequenos reparos em estruturas físicas como paredes, pisos, portas, janelas e redes hidráulicas;

  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em instalações prediais, abrangendo áreas como alvenaria e pintura;

  • Montar e instalar itens diversos como móveis, prateleiras, divisórias, luminárias e demais equipamentos;

  • Realizar inspeções periódicas para identificar falhas, vazamentos ou necessidades de reparos nos sistemas hidráulicos e demais estruturas;

  • Apoiar em obras de pequeno porte, como preparação de superfícies, assentamento de pisos, pintura e acabamentos;

  • Responder a chamados de manutenção com agilidade, garantindo qualidade na execução dos serviços;

  • Controlar o uso e a reposição de materiais, bem como o armazenamento adequado de ferramentas e equipamentos;

  • Zelar pela organização, limpeza e segurança do local de trabalho, seguindo as normas técnicas e de segurança, incluindo o uso obrigatório de EPIs.

Requisitos

  • Ensino médio completo ;

  • Amplo conhecimento em tubulações do tipo Barbará e leitura de plantas hidráulicas;

Analista de Experiência Conversacional Pleno

Somos a Stone, empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no cliente. Nosso propósito é transformar a indústria de pagamentos, servindo o empreendedor brasileiro e convertendo sonhos em resultados. Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas, valorizando trabalho em equipe, flexibilidade, desenvolvimento contínuo e pensamentos disruptivos na busca de soluções para a nossa missão.

Guiados pelos 5 pilares da nossa cultura: Own It, Live the Ride, No Bullshit, Team Play e The Reason. Buscamos gerar impacto para o cliente por meio de interações de qualidade e entrega de valor.

Somos o time responsável pelo desenvolvimento e evolução de chatbots copilotos, uma ferramenta que utiliza Inteligência Artificial Conversacional. Nossa missão é criar interações fluidas, eficientes e inteligentes que não apenas resolvam problemas, mas também encantem nossos usuários.

Como é ser um(a) Analista de Experiência Conversacional Pleno

Você será a voz do nosso cliente dentro do produto, atuando como o arquiteto das conversas do nosso copiloto. Sua missão é prover interações empáticas e eficazes entre o usuário e o chatbot, transformando interações complexas em jornadas simples e intuitivas. Você investigará o que funciona, identificará dificuldades dos clientes e proporá melhorias que impactem positivamente a satisfação e a eficiência do nosso principal canal de contato.

Principais Responsabilidades :

  • Desenhar e escrever interações objetivas, garantindo que o tom de voz do copiloto seja consistente, empático e alinhado à marca.
  • Analisar dashboards e dados para extrair insights acionáveis e responder: onde estamos falhando, o que otimizar, qual o impacto das mudanças.
  • Identificar necessidades e dores dos usuários através da análise de conversas, feedbacks e dados de uso, traduzindo achados em melhorias práticas.
  • Colaborar com times de Produto, Engenharia e Dados para construir e validar hipóteses, garantindo visão integrada da experiência.

O que esperamos de você

  • Familiaridade com análise de dados e navegação em dashboards.
  • Capacidade analítica, senso crítico e habilidade de transformar dados em ações de design conversacional.
  • Perfil curioso e proativo, com boa comunicação e colaboração em ambiente multidisciplinar.
  • Mentalidade centrada no cliente e paixão por entender suas dores.
  • Desejável: conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial, especialmente em LLMs, e técnicas de Prompt.
  • Desejável: experiência com produtos conversacionais (chatbots, voicebots) e/ou jornada do cliente.

Jornada de Trabalho

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Overview

Sylvera provides trusted ratings, tools and data for carbon credits and CDR. Our mission is to incentivize investment in real climate action. Purchasing carbon credits and CDR through the carbon markets is one of the most established and scalable ways to channel finance to effective climate solutions and work toward societal net zero. Sylvera’s data and software independently and accurately validates the impact of carbon projects that capture, remove, or avoid emissions, whether they are up and running or in development. Our tools help users optimise the climate and economic performance of projects and understand past and future market dynamics. With Sylvera, businesses, governments and developers can confidently invest in, benchmark, deliver, and report real climate impact.

Our team is made up of leading minds in climate change from scientists to policy, finance, and carbon market experts. We partner with scientific organizations, universities, governments, and think tanks to develop rigorous project assessment methodologies, leveraging the latest technology. We also collaborate with actors across the market to improve data quality, standardisation and accessibility. Founded in 2020, Sylvera has 130+ employees globally with offices in London, New York, Belgrade and Singapore. We have raised over $96 million from investors including Fidelity, Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, and Insight Partners.

What will I be doing?

As a key player in a rapidly evolving space, we are growing our commercial team in Latin America and are hiring an exceptional, self-motivated Sales Development Representative to support and drive pipeline. You’ll work closely with a dedicated Account Executive and the rest of our commercial and marketing team. Fluency in Spanish is a mandatory requirement.

Specific responsibilities

  • Inbound lead qualification and outbound prospecting
  • Identify product fit and schedule meetings with accounts
  • Strategize with Account Executives to target prospect accounts to fill pipeline
  • Conduct high-level conversations with all levels up to C-Suite and VP-level Executives to address sustainability goals
  • Create strategic emails and outbound campaigns to target prospect accounts
  • Continuously maintain and update CRM
  • Achieve monthly qualified opportunity metrics and daily KPIs

We’re looking for someone who

  • 2+ years experience in business development, sales or related field with lead qualification at all levels within organisations – managers, directors, VPs, executives
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese
  • Full professional proficiency in Spanish
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Previous startup business development experience
  • Cares deeply about the climate and ecosystems of the earth
  • Is a self-starter who thrives in evolving environments, ideally with early-stage experience
  • Brings creativity and ideas to help build the business and progress the world to Net Zero goals

What we offer

  • Equity in a rapidly growing startup
  • Private Health Insurance and Life Assurance
  • Unlimited annual leave and encouragement to actually use it
  • 4 weeks/year work from anywhere
  • Enhanced parental leave
  • Up to 20 days paid sick leave
  • No corners cut in having the best tech to do your job
  • Access to Mental Health support
  • Monthly team socials

Location

This position will be remote within the country stated in the header.

Our Values

Own it: We make new mistakes. We build on momentum, reflect on and learn from our failures.

Stay curious: We keep our focus on the long-term, even if that means short-term challenges.

Do what’s right - even when it’s hard: We take a growth mindset to our work, our customers, our market and opportunities ahead of us.

Collaborate and challenge with empathy: Our teams deliver through active collaboration. We invest in each other’s success and strengthen the company in the long run.

Empower Customers: Make extraordinary efforts to exceed customer expectations. By serving customers fully, we help direct more investment into real climate impact.

What if you’re a partial fit?

We prioritise grit, positivity, and willingness to get stuck in, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t exactly match this job description.

Equal employment opportunity

Sylvera is an equal opportunity employer: we value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Amazon Basin Reporter (Newsperson)
description:
Overview

The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Founded in 1846, AP today remains the most trusted source of fast, accurate, unbiasednews in all formats and the essential provider of the technology and services vital to the news business. More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day.

We’re seeking a curious and competitive journalist to cover the Amazon rainforest and its influence on the global climate as a reporter based in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo or Brasília), Brazil. This is a temporary grant-funded position lasting through October 2026.

Responsibilities

As part of the Climate and Environment team,this newsperson will cover many topics related to the Amazon, including but not limited to legal and illegal mining forest cutting, logging, fishing and raising of cattle, wildfires, changes in carbon dioxide emissions from deforestation, Indigenous peoples and others who live in the Amazon, government policies and enforcement, nongovernmental organizations and endemic species and habitats. The successful candidate will have the ability and willingness to work any shift, including at night and on weekends, or as coverage demands, as AP is a 24/7 operation.

We\'re looking for someone who will:

  • work among a team of reporters and editors in the U.S. and around the world to deliver spot news and enterprise coverage related to myriad happenings in the Amazon.
  • have a demonstrated history of successful beat reporting, strong source development, storytelling on deadline and the production of explanatory stories that are illuminating and entertaining.
  • have the ability to both tell stories via phone reporting and willingness to travel to various locations in the Amazon.
  • have strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with the diverse team of journalists at the AP who operate in all formats: text, photo, video, audio, digital/social, interactive and graphics.
  • have a great news sense, with the ability to communicate stories that people will want to share, like and talk about on social media and other platforms.
  • pursue innovative storytelling techniques while maintaining AP’s standards for integrity and objectivity.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, such as at least five years of full-time experience at a daily newspaper, broadcast station, online or digital news outlet, or an AP bureau or regional desk.
  • All applicants must have authorization to work in Brazil or be able to gain permission to do so.
  • Advanced-level professional competency in written and spoken English and Portuguese. Knowledge of both Portuguese and Spanish is a plus.
  • Basic proficiency in using an iPhone for photos and video is required. Advanced proficiency is a plus.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to juggle multiple projects across formats and deliver success on complex, challenging story lines.

Preferred Qualifications

We\'re looking for a reporter who can consistently break news and deliver high-impact enterprise stories that appeal to AP’s global audience. This role is for you if you are an idea machine, able to think creatively and critically, and are driven by curiosity. It is essential that you write clearly, concisely and conversationally. You should be able to develop a diverse range of sources who can provide AP with unique stories ahead of competing media outlets. You must be able to work effectively as a member of a team.

We’ll consider strong candidates who do not meet every listed qualification. You may use a cover letter to describe the unique qualifications you would bring to this role.

The application period will expire at 11:59pm on September 26, 2025.

AP seeks to build an inclusive organization grounded in respect for differences. We support all aspects of diversity and provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, status as a veteran, or other characteristic protected by law.

Behind the scenes of every successful company, there's a team of dedicated individuals committed to ensuring customers receive the support they need.

Customer support representatives are secret heroes of the business world, handling many inquiries, troubleshooting issues, and offering solutions while keeping their smiles on.

A day in the life of a customer support representative is a rollercoaster of emotions, challenges, and victories. It\'s not just about troubleshooting; it\'s about creating positive experiences for every customer, fostering trust, and leaving a lasting impression.

We are all individuals that have their own set of skills and strengths. When the whole team works as a unit, everyone has an opportunity to learn from each other.   • Proficiency in English and French.

Personal Skills:

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team.
  • Can-do mentality and strong customer focus.
  • A keen eye for details.

  • Transparency, openness, and a willingness to learn are part of our core values. We offer an international and friendly work environment with energetic company culture.
  • Aligning business and personal needs is important, so we provide flexibility to enable you to bring your best to work.
  • We support important causes and team up to find meaningful ways to give back to the community through the Fluke Day of Caring.
  • Working at Fluke gives you access to a robust career development process and exciting opportunities focused on growth.

Fortive’s essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We’re a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We’re honest about what’s working and what isn’t, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

Fluke is leading the world in creating software, test tools and technology that will support customers today and in the future. title: ELETRICISTA
description:
O Eletricista é responsável por executar a manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva de sistemas elétricos, garantindo o pleno funcionamento das instalações e a segurança dos ambientes. Este profissional desempenha um papel crucial na manutenção e operação eficiente dos equipamentos e sistemas da empresa.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em sistemas elétricos, mecânicos e estruturais, garantindo o funcionamento adequado e seguro dos equipamentos e instalações.
  • Diagnosticar e reparar falhas e defeitos em sistemas elétricos, como painéis, fiações, tomadas e interruptores, além de sistemas mecânicos e hidráulicos conforme necessário.
  • Executar a instalação e substituição de componentes elétricos e mecânicos, como motores, circuitos e dispositivos de controle.
  • Realizar inspeções regulares nos sistemas e equipamentos para identificar e corrigir possíveis problemas antes que se tornem críticos.
  • Ler e interpretar esquemas elétricos, diagramas e manuais técnicos para realizar as manutenções e reparos de acordo com as especificações.
  • Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de manutenção realizadas, incluindo as peças substituídas e os problemas encontrados.
  • Trabalhar em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulamentos aplicáveis, utilizando equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) e técnicas seguras.
  • Colaborar com outros membros da equipe e supervisores para garantir a eficiência e a qualidade na execução das atividades.
  • Participar de treinamentos e atualizações técnicas para se manter informado sobre novas tecnologias e práticas de manutenção.
  • Responder a chamadas de emergência e realizar reparos urgentes para minimizar o tempo de inatividade e garantir a continuidade das operações.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo ou técnico na área de elétrica ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência prévia em manutenção elétrica, mecânica e estrutural, com conhecimento em diagnóstico e reparo de falhas.
  • Conhecimento técnico em sistemas elétricos, incluindo leitura de esquemas e diagramas.
  • Certificações e treinamentos específicos na área de manutenção (desejável).
  • Experiência com ferramentas e equipamentos de manutenção.

Nossa Cultura

Colaboração: Compartilhamos conhecimento, trabalhamos em equipe, agimos com empatia, mantemos uma comunicação ativa e transparente. Protagonismo: Somos criativos, adaptáveis e proativos, tomamos a iniciativa e assumimos a responsabilidade. Cliente no centro: Compreendemos o cliente, somos acessíveis e respondemos com agilidade. Queremos ser a sua escolha! Nossa equipe de Infraestrutura e Project Finance está buscando um(a) Estagiário(a) para atuar no escritório do Rio de Janeiro.

Sobre a área

Nossa área de Infraestrutura e Financiamento de Projetos é formada por profissionais versáteis e com uma expertise diferenciada. Nossa ampla gama de atuação e a experiência de nossos advogados nos dão uma visão única das questões e tendências regulatórias de setores e agências reguladoras brasileiras. Nossa prática abrange desde o assessoramento a processos de licitação e apresentação de pleitos perante agências reguladoras, até a estruturação societária, contratual e financeira de projetos. Nossa equipe atuou em operações pioneiras, como, por exemplo, o primeiro project finance internacional limited-recourse para projeto greenfield, o primeiro project finance non recourse para produção de petróleo, o primeiro project bond internacional e o primeiro bond internacional lastreado em royalties de petróleo. Entre nossos clientes estão as maiores instituições financeiras mundiais, bancos de desenvolvimento, agências multilaterais, agências de crédito à exportação (ECAs) e fundos de investimento, bem como os empreendedores, sponsors, offtakers e construtoras mais ativas e atuantes nesse mercado.

Experiência de Quem Faz

A Serviços Integrados TecBan nasceu da experiência na gestão da maior rede de caixas eletrônicos em volume de saques, o Banco24Horas. Depois de muitos anos fazendo acontecer com o Banco24Horas, decidimos compartilhar a nossa excelência e experiência com o mercado.

A Serviços Integrados TecBan tem um papel de agente de transformação e gestão operacional nos pilares de logística, serviços de manutenção, conservação, instalação e gerenciamento de bens e negócios de terceiros.

Realizamos tarefas complicadas, com um compromisso simples: facilitar o dia a dia dos negócios e dos nossos clientes. Temos soluções que podem ser adquiridas de forma modular e customizada, conforme a necessidade dos clientes nas frentes: obras civis e manutenção predial; revitalização de equipamentos; laboratório de reparo de placas, módulos e equipamentos eletrônicos; logística (transporte e armazenamento); gestão de redes de equipamentos e de toda infraestrutura; monitoração e acompanhamento de desempenho; e muito mais.

Temos diversas bases espalhadas pelo Brasil, todas com uma infraestrutura tecnológica avançada e investimento contínuo em tecnologia e segurança.

Reiterando nosso compromisso com a diversidade e inclusão, convidamos pessoas negras, indígenas, mulheres, pessoas com deficiência, pessoas de diversas gerações e 50+, pessoas neurodivergentes e pessoas LGBTQIAPN+ a enviarem suas candidaturas para as vagas de estágio, aprendiz e trabalho no grupo TecBan.

title: Técnico(a) de Manutenção de SE III - Itaboraí/RJ
description:
Técnico(a) de Manutenção de SE III - Itaboraí/RJ

A Cotesa tem como propósito ser a melhor parceira do setor elétrico brasileiro. Tem como diretriz de atuação a máxima eficiência, aliada à responsabilidade socioambiental e à segurança de suas equipes, valores compartilhados por seus colaboradores. Queremos em nosso time pessoas comprometidas, que vistam a camisa e estejam sempre dispostas a aperfeiçoar processos e a se engajar em novos desafios. Queremos que nossos colaboradores cresçam junto com a empresa. Se esse é o seu perfil e se você tem tanta paixão pela energia como nós, ficaremos felizes em conhecer você!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Missão da Função:

  • Prestar serviços de manutenção nas instalações, cumprindo os requisitos e processos internos com máxima qualidade e segurança.

Responsabilidade do Técnico de Manutenção II:

  • Executar as manutenções preditivas, preventivas e corretivas em Usina e Subestações, realizando inspeções diárias, semanais, mensais, trimestrais, semestrais, anuais e plurianuais, cumprindo os procedimentos internos, identificando os desvios e sugerir as ações necessárias para o cumprimento e mantendo o Sistema de Gestão da Manutenção atualizado a fim de cumprir com o plano de manutenção e garantir a máxima confiabilidade e disponibilidade dos ativos;
  • Acompanhar as atividades de comissionamento e recepção de novos equipamentos de Usina e subestações, a fim de obter a liberação para entrada em operação;
  • Realizar o apontamento de defeitos/anomalias decorrentes das inspeções realizadas nas Instalações, no software de gerenciamento da manutenção, com objetivo de manter atualizado o planejamento de manutenções corretivas;
  • Zelar pelo bom uso e conservação das ferramentas e instrumentos de manutenção de Instalações, com objetivo de manter a segurança e o patrimônio da empresa;
  • Realizar o atendimento às emergenciais, realizar o recebimento de materiais e equipamentos, conferindo com a nota fiscal, controlando, organizando, limpando e mantendo a boa conservação dos sobressalentes, cumprindo os procedimentos estabelecidos, sugerindo melhorias nas condições de armazenamento, objetivando manter o estoque nas melhores condições de utilização, executando inspeções especiais nas Instalações, localizando e identificando as causas de desligamentos automáticos, a fim de reestabelecer os equipamentos no menor prazo possível;
  • Conduzir os veículos da empresa cumprindo a legislação de trânsito e política de frotas, zelando pela segurança, pelo ativo e imagem da COTESA e do Cliente;
  • Cumprir as normativas legais e procedimentos internos, fazendo a correta utilização e conservação dos EPIs e EPC, atuando preventivamente na realização das atividades, identificando situações de risco, propondo ao seu superior imediato medidas de controle, a fim zelar pelas questões de saúde e segurança;
  • Contribuir para a elaboração dos relatórios mensais e técnicos, seguindo os padrões pré-estabelecidos pela engenharia, encaminhando para revisão do supervisor, a fim de cumprir os prazos e requisitos legais do contrato;
  • Fornecer informações técnicas decorrente de falhas e de desempenho de equipamentos e sistemas, relatando informações específicas, a fim de subsidiar a análise dos especialistas da área de Engenharia;
  • Reconhecer os eventos de natureza operativa, em horário de trabalho e quando comunicado pela Operação (tais como desligamentos automáticos, oscilações sistêmicas, alarmes de alta severidade, entre outros...), tomando as providências locais solicitadas pela Operação, afim de garantir máxima disponibilidade dos ativo;
  • Executar a operação local nas instalações telecontroladas, quando houver perda da operação remota, atendendo aos procedimentos de rede, rotinas operacionais e as instruções de operação local, com objetivo de garantir a máxima disponibilidade dos ativos;
  • Contribuir para a conservação das instalações civis, a fim de garantir boas condições de infraestrutura para o adequado desenvolvimento das atividades;
  • Zelar pelo bom relacionamento entre agentes acessantes/acessada, visando atender os acordos operativos e de compartilhamento das instalações, com o objetivo de manter a máxima cooperação entre as partes;
  • Zelar pelo bom relacionamento com a equipe local do cliente, a fim de compatibilizar as demandas de serviços decorrentes de solicitações do mesmo e as demandas próprias;
  • Cumprir com as questões ambientais, orientando os demais colegas da equipe, a fim de atender a legislação e programas ambientais vigentes oriundos do licenciamento do empreendimento;
  • Participar da execução dos Planos de Contingência e/ou Planos de Atendimento a Emergências e/ou Planos de Segurança em Barragens, seguindo os procedimentos internos, identificando os desvios e implementando as ações necessárias para o cumprimento, dimensionando os recursos necessários, a fim de garantir a operacionalidade e segurança das pessoas e instalações;
  • Prestar atendimento e realizar outras atividades profissionais correlatas e inerentes ao cargo exercido, conforme orientação e/ou solicitação do superior imediato.

Responsabilidade do Técnico de Manutenção III: Desenvolverá todas as responsabilidades já descritas para o Técnico de Manutenção II e ainda:

  • Contribuir com o planejamento, coordenação e orientação para execução das atividades do demais colegas da equipe, a fim de garantir a segurança, qualidade do trabalho, o cumprimento dos prazos, metas e indicadores estabelecidos, bem como, identificar possibilidades de melhorias nos processos existentes;
  • Executar os planos de manutenção dos ativos, executado por equipe própria ou terceirizada, cumprindo e fazendo cumprir os procedimentos internos. Identificar os desvios e sugerir ações necessárias para o cumprimento, dimensionando os recursos necessários, mantendo o Sistema de Gestão da Manutenção atualizado com as informações decorrentes da execução do serviço, a fim de garantir a disponibilidade operacional dos ativos;
  • Auxiliar no monitoramento dos indicadores da área, identificando fragilidades e distorções, sugerindo ações e auxiliando o supervisor na implementação de ações corretivas, a fim de obter melhores resultados nos processos da área e subsidiar a tomada de decisão em nível estratégico;
  • Recepcionar e acompanhar visitas e auditorias de órgãos externos, conforme orientação do superior imediato, atendendo as demandas e apresentando documentos, a fim de demonstrar que os requisitos legais estão sendo cumpridos conforme as normativas estabelecidas;
  • Auxiliar o supervisor na administração Adm/ Financeira/Contábil local (caixa), cumprindo com os procedimentos administrativos financeiros, contribuindo para a emissão de relatórios de entradas e saídas, com suporte em notas fiscais, a fim de cumprir com os procedimentos administrativo financeiros;
  • Contribuir para a elaboração e execução dos Planos de Contingência e/ou Planos de Atendimento a Emergências e/ou Planos de Segurança em Barragens, seguindo os procedimentos internos, identificando os desvios e implementando as ações necessárias para o cumprimento, dimensionando os recursos necessários, a fim de garantir a operacionalidade e segurança das pessoas e instalações;
  • Contribuir para a elaboração de especificações técnicas, seguindo procedimento internos, a fim de realizar a contração de serviços especializados;
  • Contribuir com o desenvolvimento dos demais colegas da equipe, orientando a execução das atividades e compartilhando conhecimentos, reportando ao supervisor dificuldades e necessidades de treinamento, a fim de contribuir para a capacitação da equipe.

Requisitos e qualificações

Obrigatórios:

  • Técnico em Eletrotécnico, Eletromecânica, Mecânica, Automação, Eletrônica e/ou afins;
  • Carteira de habilitação Cat. B;
  • Registro ativo no conselho de classe;
  • Conhecimento do pacote Office;
  • Experiência em Manutenção de Ativos;

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento no Software Gestão da Manutenção EquipMaint.

Informações adicionais:

  • Benefícios: Vale alimentação/Refeição; Seguro de vida; Plano de Saúde; Plano odontológico; Auxílio educação; Parcerias de Desconto (Ipog, Unisul, Clinica Buriti);
  • Local de trabalho: Itaboraí (RJ);
  • Local de residência: Itaboraí (RJ);

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

Neste contexto a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Rio de Janeiro, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local; Educação para o consumo consciente de energia.

Divulgar os projetos, apoiando em atividades e eventos externos;
